stages.title: 晶體、晶圓製備與清洗
stages.titleEn: Crystal growth, wafer preparation and cleaning

stages.title: 井區、通道植入與退火
stages.titleEn: Well and channel implantation and annealing

stages.title: 閘極圖案與內外間隔層
層間介電膜與化學機械平坦化
鑲嵌式互連圖形與蝕刻
金屬阻障、填充與多層連接

先進電晶體、背面供電與製造交接

selectedSteps.title: 建立 CMOS 剖面層序
selectedSteps.objective: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
selectedSteps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
selectedSteps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.

knowledge.title: 本步的可檢核證據
knowledge.text: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 對應操作：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。
knowledge.textEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 量測數字只有在量測位置、參考面、單位與方法一致時才可比較；示範驗收界線由課程情境提供，不是通用產業規格。 本步特別排查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements are comparable only with consistent locations, reference planes, units and methods. Exercise acceptance limits are scenario inputs, not universal industry specifications. Specifically examine: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes.

selectedSteps.title: 選擇沉積機制
selectedSteps.objective: 選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.
selectedSteps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone.
selectedSteps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：沉積機制不符合覆蓋幾何。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Deposition mechanism incompatible with coverage geometry. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.

knowledge.title: 本步的可檢核證據
knowledge.text: 選型根據覆蓋需求與材料限制，不只看沉積速度。 對應操作：對同一溝槽比較 PVD、CVD 與 ALD 成長示意，標示方向性與表面反應。
knowledge.textEn: Selection follows coverage and material constraints, not deposition speed alone. Corresponding operation: Compare PVD, CVD and ALD growth in the same trench and label directionality and surface reactions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 名義膜厚不足以決定共形性、連續性或材料品質。ALD 的自限半反應可改善控制，但每循環成長量依材料及條件而變。 本步特別排查：沉積機制不符合覆蓋幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal thickness does not determine conformality, continuity or material quality. Self-limiting ALD half-reactions improve control, but growth per cycle depends on material and conditions. Specifically examine: Deposition mechanism incompatible with coverage geometry.

selectedSteps.title: 延伸接面剖面建模
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「延伸接面剖面建模」的證據判讀，辨識『比較淺接面濃度剖面與通道邊界』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Evaluate model extension-junction profiles by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
selectedSteps.failure: 診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.

knowledge.title: 延伸接面剖面建模的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of model extension-junction profiles
knowledge.text: 佈植劑量、深度分佈、晶格損傷與電性活化是不同變量；外延與佈植屬可替代或組合的整合分支。 本題具體操作為「比較淺接面濃度剖面與通道邊界」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Implanted dose, depth distribution, lattice damage and electrical activation are different variables; epitaxy and implantation are alternative or combined integration branches. Here the concrete task is: Compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 延伸接面剖面建模的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for model extension-junction profiles
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示」。但只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. However, peak concentration alone hides deep tails; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

selectedSteps.title: 頂層金屬完整性
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「頂層金屬完整性」的證據判讀，辨識『檢查最上層導體輪廓與暴露表面』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Evaluate inspect top-metal integrity by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: inspect top-level conductor profiles and exposed surfaces.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：最終保護前無未解釋裂縫或橋接。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: no unexplained cracks or bridges remain before protection. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
selectedSteps.failure: 診斷提醒：蓋上鈍化會使既有缺陷更難定位。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: passivation makes preexisting defects harder to locate. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.

knowledge.title: 頂層金屬完整性的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of inspect top-metal integrity
knowledge.text: 鈍化保護與薄化支撐要一起設計；晶圓厚度、殘餘損傷、翹曲與後續封裝介面是不同放行項。 本題具體操作為「檢查最上層導體輪廓與暴露表面」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Passivation protection and thinning support are designed together; thickness, residual damage, bow and packaging interfaces require separate acceptance evidence. Here the concrete task is: Inspect top-level conductor profiles and exposed surfaces. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 頂層金屬完整性的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for inspect top-metal integrity
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「最終保護前無未解釋裂縫或橋接」。但蓋上鈍化會使既有缺陷更難定位；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: No unexplained cracks or bridges remain before protection. However, passivation makes preexisting defects harder to locate; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

selectedSteps.title: 良品晶圓製造交接
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「良品晶圓製造交接」的證據判讀，辨識『整合缺陷位置、封裝介面與未結案限制』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Evaluate handoff qualified wafers by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: combine defect locations, packaging interfaces and open restrictions.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
selectedSteps.failure: 診斷提醒：只有合格標籤而無證據不足以交接。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: a pass label without evidence is insufficient for handoff. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.

knowledge.title: 良品晶圓製造交接的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of handoff qualified wafers
knowledge.text: 本模組是互斥或可組合架構的比較分支：FinFET、GAA 與背面供電並非每條製程都同時存在；學習順序不等於實際晶圓行程。 本題具體操作為「整合缺陷位置、封裝介面與未結案限制」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: This module compares alternative or combinable architectures: FinFETs, GAA and backside power do not occur together in every flow. Learning order is not a wafer traveler. Here the concrete task is: Combine defect locations, packaging interfaces and open restrictions. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 良品晶圓製造交接的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for handoff qualified wafers
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制」。但只有合格標籤而無證據不足以交接；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: The receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. However, a pass label without evidence is insufficient for handoff; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

selectedSteps.title: 解讀節點名稱
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「解讀節點名稱」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for interpret node names.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 節點標籤代表技術世代，應以公開 PPA 與結構資料比較。
knowledge.textEn: Node labels identify technology generations; comparisons need public PPA and structural data.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 把節點標籤與閘長、接觸間距、金屬間距分成不同欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Separate node label, gate length, contact pitch and metal pitch in a table.

selectedSteps.title: 理解通道釋放
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「理解通道釋放」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for understand channel release.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 選擇性移除需保留通道完整性並控制殘留，不能只追求移除速度。
knowledge.textEn: Selective removal must preserve channels and control residues rather than maximize removal speed alone.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 用兩個失效案例說明過蝕刻與釋放不足。
knowledge.textEn: Illustrate over-etch and incomplete release with two failure cases.

selectedSteps.title: 分離訊號與電源
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「分離訊號與電源」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for separate signal and power.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 背面供電把部分電源路徑移到晶圓背側，釋出正面布線資源。
knowledge.textEn: Backside power moves part of the power network to the wafer rear and frees front-side routing resources.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 在雙面示意圖分別畫出訊號線與供電線。
knowledge.textEn: Draw signal and power routes separately on a two-sided schematic.

selectedSteps.title: 建立量測鏈
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「建立量測鏈」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for build a measurement chain.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 間接量測需校準模型與不確定度，單一影像不能證明全部電性。
knowledge.textEn: Indirect metrology requires model calibration and uncertainty; one image cannot establish every electrical property.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 把結構量測與電性量測連到不同驗證問題。
knowledge.textEn: Map structural and electrical measurements to distinct verification questions.

selectedSteps.title: 建立技術成熟度紀錄
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「建立技術成熟度紀錄」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for record technology maturity.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 論文展示、風險試產與量產資格是不同證據等級。
knowledge.textEn: A paper demonstration, risk production and volume qualification represent different evidence levels.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 為每個技術主張附日期、來源及成熟度標籤。
knowledge.textEn: Attach a date, source and maturity label to each technology claim.

selectedSteps.title: 辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界
selectedSteps.titleEn: Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP
selectedSteps.objective: 界定本批晶圓的材料層與後續用途。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Identify the material stack and intended next process.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
selectedSteps.failure: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.

knowledge.title: 加工對象
knowledge.text: 裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。
knowledge.textEn: Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns.

knowledge.title: 終點的意義
knowledge.text: 停止條件取決於下一製程需求，不能只以外觀發亮決定。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping depends on the next process, not just a shiny appearance.

selectedSteps.title: 檢查邊緣完整性與搬運接觸
selectedSteps.titleEn: Inspect edge integrity and handling contact
selectedSteps.objective: 辨認可能形成碎屑或後續破片的邊緣狀況。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Recognize edge conditions that can generate debris or later fracture.
selectedSteps.observation: 注意「平滑倒角」與不規則缺口的形狀差異，以及缺口附近的散落粒子。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Distinguish a smooth bevel from an irregular chip and look for nearby debris.
selectedSteps.failure: 把正常倒角誤判為缺角會造成誤剔除；只看中心表面則可能漏掉裂紋。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Mistaking a bevel for a chip causes false rejects; viewing only the center can miss cracks.

knowledge.title: 邊緣應力
knowledge.text: 邊緣形貌影響接觸與應力集中，也可能成為粒子來源。
knowledge.textEn: Edge geometry influences contact and stress concentration and can become a particle source.

knowledge.title: 缺陷定位
knowledge.text: 同一方位重複出現缺口可提示搬運或載具接觸問題。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated chips at the same orientation can suggest a handling or carrier-contact issue.

selectedSteps.title: 分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate pad, slurry and relative motion
selectedSteps.objective: 建立化學與機械作用共同去除材料的模型。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Model removal as coupled chemical and mechanical action.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
selectedSteps.failure: 把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.

knowledge.title: 耦合作用
knowledge.text: CMP 同時依靠化學環境與機械接觸，不能僅視為乾磨。
knowledge.textEn: CMP couples a chemical environment with mechanical contact; it is not simply dry abrasion.

knowledge.title: 變因隔離
knowledge.text: 一次比較一個變因，才容易判別局部不均的來源。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing one variable at a time helps identify the origin of nonuniformity.

selectedSteps.title: 建立拋光終點與過拋辨識
selectedSteps.objective: 用目標剩餘量和缺陷條件共同決定停止。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Combine remaining-material targets and defect conditions when deciding to stop.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察缺陷改善與厚度損失可能同時發生，兩者需共同判讀。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observe that defect improvement and thickness loss can occur together and must be interpreted jointly.
selectedSteps.failure: 將時間到達視為唯一終點時，工具漂移會被漏掉；要求相應的量測佐證。
selectedSteps.failureEn: A time-only endpoint can miss tool drift; require matching measurement evidence.

knowledge.title: 多條件終點
knowledge.text: 終點是符合要求的狀態，不只是計時器結束。
knowledge.textEn: An endpoint is a required state, not merely the end of a timer.

knowledge.title: 過拋代價
knowledge.text: 額外去除可能消耗幾何餘量，不能假定越久越好。
knowledge.textEn: Extra removal can consume geometric margin; longer is not automatically better.

selectedSteps.title: 整合晶圓放行與異常處置
selectedSteps.objective: 用可追溯證據決定放行、複查或隔離。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Decide release, review or quarantine using traceable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
selectedSteps.failure: 若重工會超出剩餘厚度預算，就不能僅因想降低報廢率而批准。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Do not authorize rework that exceeds the remaining thickness budget just to reduce rejects.

knowledge.title: 放行證據鏈
knowledge.text: 產品放行需要相互一致的多項證據，而非挑選最漂亮的一項。
knowledge.textEn: Release needs consistent evidence across criteria, not selection of the most favorable result.

knowledge.title: 重工可行性
knowledge.text: 重工決策仍受材料餘量與缺陷機制限制。
knowledge.textEn: Rework remains constrained by material allowance and the defect mechanism.

stages.title: 電性、可靠度與設計審查

selectedSteps.title: 畫出電源與訊號的兩條路徑
selectedSteps.titleEn: Draw separate power and signal paths
selectedSteps.objective: 區分供電網路與訊號傳播。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Distinguish power distribution from signal propagation.
selectedSteps.observation: 供電轉到背面後，訊號層並未消失。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Moving power does not eliminate signal layers.
selectedSteps.failure: 若只畫 VDD，補回回流路徑後再分析壓降。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If only VDD is drawn, add the return path before analyzing drop.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面供電改變配線分工，不代表把所有訊號移到背面。
knowledge.textEn: Backside power changes routing allocation; it does not move every signal backside.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 電壓是兩點之差，供電與回流都影響元件實際供應。
knowledge.textEn: Voltage is a difference between points; both supply and return affect the device.

selectedSteps.title: 建立前後面方向與標記
selectedSteps.objective: 避免翻面後座標與極性誤判。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Avoid coordinate and polarity errors after flipping.
selectedSteps.observation: 翻轉與平面旋轉對圖案的影響不同。
selectedSteps.observationEn: A flip and an in-plane rotation transform patterns differently.
selectedSteps.failure: 對稱標記無法辨認鏡像時，增加不對稱識別。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Add an asymmetric identifier if marks cannot distinguish mirroring.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面加工需要將量測座標連回正面元件。
knowledge.textEn: Backside processing must relate measurements to frontside devices.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 標記本身也需在薄化及堆疊後可辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Marks must remain identifiable after thinning and stacking.

selectedSteps.title: 比較埋藏軌與直接接觸
selectedSteps.objective: 辨識不同背面連接策略的介面。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Identify interfaces in alternative backside connections.
selectedSteps.observation: 不同方案可共享目標但不共享所有步驟。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Schemes can share goals without sharing every process step.
selectedSteps.failure: 若移植一個方案的規則，先確認結構是否相同。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Check structural equivalence before transferring a rule.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面連接不是單一固定架構。
knowledge.textEn: Backside connectivity is not one fixed architecture.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 較短路徑仍需付出可製造性與隔離驗證。
knowledge.textEn: A shorter path still requires manufacturability and isolation verification.

selectedSteps.title: 建立晶圓內電性地圖
selectedSteps.objective: 區分共同偏移與局部缺陷。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Separate shared shifts from local faults.
selectedSteps.observation: 相關位置可提出假說，不能單獨證明原因。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Spatial correlation suggests a hypothesis but does not prove causation.
selectedSteps.failure: 若只挑單點最佳結果，恢復全圖及失敗點。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Restore the full map and failures if only the best point was selected.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 位置配對能串接多種量測證據。
knowledge.textEn: Spatial pairing connects different measurement evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 全片均值會掩蓋局部短路或高阻。
knowledge.textEn: A whole-wafer average can hide local shorts or high resistance.

selectedSteps.title: 完成總工程師整合審查
selectedSteps.objective: 建立可追溯且不誇大結論的交付包。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Produce a traceable review package without overstating results.
selectedSteps.observation: 證據完整度與性能數字大小是兩回事。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Evidence completeness differs from the size of a performance gain.
selectedSteps.failure: 沒有實測或有效模型的項目維持待驗證，不填入廠商保證。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Keep unsupported items unverified rather than adding manufacturer guarantees.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 設計審查評估證據與限制，不只展示最漂亮的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Design review evaluates evidence and limits, not only favorable results.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 教育模型可訓練判讀，但不取代製程資格認證。
knowledge.textEn: Educational models train interpretation but do not replace process qualification.

title: 高數值孔徑 EUV 成像

selectedSteps.title: 分開節點名稱與實際線寬
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate node labels from feature dimensions
selectedSteps.objective: 建立不混淆的尺度表。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build an unambiguous scale table.
selectedSteps.observation: 節點名稱不能直接代入每個幾何尺寸。
selectedSteps.observationEn: A node label is not every physical dimension.
selectedSteps.failure: 若把「2 nm」當成所有線寬，退回欄位定義。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Revisit definitions if a 2 nm label is treated as every linewidth.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 微影解析度與半導體節點命名描述不同層面。
knowledge.textEn: Lithographic resolution and node naming describe different aspects.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 節距包含線與間距，不能只報線寬。
knowledge.textEn: Pitch includes a line and space; linewidth alone is insufficient.

selectedSteps.title: 辨認光罩三維效應
selectedSteps.objective: 區分平面設計與真實吸收層。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Distinguish layout from a physical absorber stack.
selectedSteps.observation: 光罩不是沒有厚度的黑白投影片。
selectedSteps.observationEn: A mask is not a thickness-free black-and-white transparency.
selectedSteps.failure: 若平面模型無法說明方向差異，列入三維光學效應。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Consider 3D optics when a planar model cannot explain orientation effects.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 吸收層與多層膜可改變相位及影像對比。
knowledge.textEn: Absorber and multilayer structures can affect phase and contrast.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不同圖案方向可能需要分開評估。
knowledge.textEn: Different pattern orientations may need separate evaluation.

selectedSteps.title: 推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描
selectedSteps.titleEn: Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning
selectedSteps.objective: 建立兩平台相對運動的概念。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Model relative motion of both stages.
selectedSteps.observation: 平台各自位置正確仍須保持相對同步。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Individually correct positions still require relative synchronization.
selectedSteps.failure: 若兩平台使用相同位移卻倍率不同，重算對應關係。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Recalculate mapping if both stages move equally despite demagnification.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 掃描成像需要平台運動與光學倍率一致。
knowledge.textEn: Scanning requires motion consistent with optical scaling.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 同步誤差需按曝光時刻評估。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronization error must be evaluated during exposure.

selectedSteps.title: 建立焦距與劑量矩陣
selectedSteps.objective: 以多條件找可接受製程區域。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Find acceptable regions across conditions.
selectedSteps.observation: 單一最佳點不代表有寬廣製程視窗。
selectedSteps.observationEn: One optimum point does not establish a broad process window.
selectedSteps.failure: 若只選線寬最接近的一格，加入缺陷與鄰近格穩定性。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Add defects and neighboring-condition stability to closest-width selection.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 製程視窗是同時滿足條件的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A process window is a range satisfying joint conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 裕量比單次最佳結果更有助於穩定性判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Margin is more informative about robustness than one optimum result.

selectedSteps.title: 完成成像整合交付
selectedSteps.objective: 用完整證據支持下一輪試驗。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Support the next experiment with complete evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 漂亮影像不能取代統計與流程相容證據。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Attractive images cannot replace statistics and integration evidence.
selectedSteps.failure: 缺乏電性或轉移結果時，限制結論到已驗證階段。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Limit conclusions to verified stages when electrical or transfer evidence is absent.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 整合成熟度需要多種證據互相支持。
knowledge.textEn: Integration maturity requires mutually supporting evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 本課程是成像原理審查，不是光刻機建造藍圖。
knowledge.textEn: This course reviews imaging principles, not lithography-machine construction blueprints.

selectedSteps.title: 辨識晶向
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「辨識晶向」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify crystal orientation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 辨識晶向的原理
knowledge.text: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
knowledge.textEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

selectedSteps.title: 線徑與槽距
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「線徑與槽距」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate wire diameter and pitch, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「線徑、切縫與導輪槽距是不同幾何量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wire diameter, kerf and guide-groove pitch differ. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：晶圓表面外觀平整就可排除次表面裂紋。 應回到「線徑與槽距」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: A flat-looking surface rules out subsurface cracks. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate wire diameter and pitch and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 線徑與槽距的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate wire diameter and pitch principle
knowledge.text: 線徑、切縫與導輪槽距是不同幾何量。
knowledge.textEn: Wire diameter, kerf and guide-groove pitch differ.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 線網的機械耦合使單條線受力改變可能影響相鄰切面，進給穩定性需與導輪狀態一起看。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical coupling in a wire web means one load change can affect neighboring cuts; inspect feed stability with guide condition.

selectedSteps.title: 總厚度變異
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「總厚度變異」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure total thickness variation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure total thickness variation and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 總厚度變異的原理
knowledge.text: TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。
knowledge.textEn: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: TTV 用兩面的局部間距計算；弓形用中面相對參考面計算，因此厚度均勻的片仍可能彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: TTV measures local separation of both faces while bow describes the median surface; uniform thickness can coexist with curvature.

selectedSteps.title: 材料利用率
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「材料利用率」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compute material utilization, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「材料利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compute material utilization and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 材料利用率的原理
knowledge.text: 提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。
knowledge.textEn: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 切片端減少切縫的收益，若被後段新增的損傷移除量抵銷，整體矽利用率可能沒有增加。
knowledge.textEn: A smaller kerf may not improve overall silicon utilization if it requires more downstream damage removal.

selectedSteps.title: 切片批次放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「切片批次放行」的工程驗收單，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release a slicing lot, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「厚度、損傷、邊緣與追溯證據須同時交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「切片批次放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release a slicing lot and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 切片批次放行的原理
knowledge.text: 厚度、損傷、邊緣與追溯證據須同時交付。
knowledge.textEn: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 切片端減少切縫的收益，若被後段新增的損傷移除量抵銷，整體矽利用率可能沒有增加。
knowledge.textEn: A smaller kerf may not improve overall silicon utilization if it requires more downstream damage removal.

selectedSteps.title: 區分磊晶與沉積
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「區分磊晶與沉積」的因果圖，把膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for distinguish epitaxy from deposition, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「區分磊晶與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for distinguish epitaxy from deposition and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 區分磊晶與沉積的原理
knowledge.text: 磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。
knowledge.textEn: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 基板提供晶格模板，但摻雜、殘留氧化物與缺陷會改變新生晶層的電性與完整性。
knowledge.textEn: The substrate provides lattice registry, but doping, oxide and defects affect the new layer’s electrical and structural quality.

selectedSteps.title: 反應控制區
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「反應控制區」的因果圖，把膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify reaction-limited growth, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「反應受限區對表面溫度較敏感。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Reaction-limited growth is more sensitive to surface temperature. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：晶圓表面外觀平整就可排除次表面裂紋。 應回到「反應控制區」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: A flat-looking surface rules out subsurface cracks. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify reaction-limited growth and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 反應控制區的原理
knowledge.text: 反應受限區對表面溫度較敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction-limited growth is more sensitive to surface temperature.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 表面反應與邊界層傳質是串聯的限制；改善其中較快一項可能無法增加總成長速率。
knowledge.textEn: Surface reaction and boundary-layer transport impose serial limits; accelerating the faster process may not raise growth rate.

selectedSteps.title: 厚度均勻圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「厚度均勻圖」的因果圖，把膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map thickness uniformity, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「中心邊緣與方位點都需納入採樣。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sampling should include radial and azimuthal positions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「厚度均勻圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map thickness uniformity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 厚度均勻圖的原理
knowledge.text: 中心邊緣與方位點都需納入採樣。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling should include radial and azimuthal positions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 電阻率近似由載子濃度與遷移率乘積決定，因此只量電阻率無法唯一重建深度摻雜輪廓。
knowledge.textEn: Resistivity depends approximately on carrier density times mobility, so resistivity alone cannot reconstruct a unique doping profile.

selectedSteps.title: 熱預算帳本
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「熱預算帳本」的因果圖，把膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for build a thermal-budget ledger, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「相同最終膜厚不代表相同熱歷程。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Equal final thickness does not imply equal thermal history. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「熱預算帳本」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for build a thermal-budget ledger and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 熱預算帳本的原理
knowledge.text: 相同最終膜厚不代表相同熱歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Equal final thickness does not imply equal thermal history.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 磊晶層的初始缺陷、後段擴散及接觸加工會共同決定元件結果，材料放行需保留熱歷程版本。
knowledge.textEn: Initial epitaxial defects, subsequent diffusion and contact processing jointly determine device outcomes; retain thermal-history versions.

selectedSteps.title: 磊晶交接檔
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「磊晶交接檔」的工程驗收單，把膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for assemble the epitaxy dossier, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚、摻雜、缺陷與熱歷程共同定義材料品質。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness, doping, defects and thermal history jointly define quality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「磊晶交接檔」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assemble the epitaxy dossier and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 磊晶交接檔的原理
knowledge.text: 膜厚、摻雜、缺陷與熱歷程共同定義材料品質。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness, doping, defects and thermal history jointly define quality.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 磊晶層的初始缺陷、後段擴散及接觸加工會共同決定元件結果，材料放行需保留熱歷程版本。
knowledge.textEn: Initial epitaxial defects, subsequent diffusion and contact processing jointly determine device outcomes; retain thermal-history versions.

title: 絕緣層上覆矽晶圓製造

selectedSteps.title: 辨認三層結構
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「辨認三層結構」的因果圖，把頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify the three-layer stack, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨認三層結構」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the three-layer stack and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 辨認三層結構的原理
knowledge.text: 頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: SOI 的支撐晶圓承擔機械功能，埋氧切斷直流通路，頂層提供通道；三者厚度不能只按總厚度驗收。
knowledge.textEn: SOI handle, oxide and top silicon provide support, insulation and channels; total thickness alone cannot accept the stack.

selectedSteps.title: 離子層深度
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「離子層深度」的因果圖，把頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for locate the implanted split layer, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「佈植深度分布決定弱化層位置的不確定度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Implant depth distribution sets split-layer position uncertainty. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：晶圓表面外觀平整就可排除次表面裂紋。 應回到「離子層深度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: A flat-looking surface rules out subsurface cracks. Revisit assumptions and sampling for locate the implanted split layer and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 離子層深度的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Locate the implanted split layer principle
knowledge.text: 佈植深度分布決定弱化層位置的不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Implant depth distribution sets split-layer position uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 分裂深度由佈植輪廓及後續演化共同決定；能量設定是輸入，而完成轉移後的厚度圖才是輸出證據。
knowledge.textEn: Splitting depends on implant profiles and later evolution; implant energy is an input while transferred-thickness maps are output evidence.

selectedSteps.title: 頂矽厚度圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「頂矽厚度圖」的因果圖，把頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map top-silicon thickness, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「厚度非均勻可能轉成元件臨界電壓變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「頂矽厚度圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map top-silicon thickness and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 頂矽厚度圖的原理
knowledge.text: 厚度非均勻可能轉成元件臨界電壓變異。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鍵合空洞改變局部機械支撐與熱路徑；即使頂矽厚度正常，局部空洞仍可能影響後續加工。
knowledge.textEn: Bond voids alter support and heat paths, so normal top-silicon thickness does not eliminate void-related processing risks.

selectedSteps.title: 自熱效應
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「自熱效應」的因果圖，把頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for analyze self-heating, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋氧的熱阻可提高局部溫升。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「自熱效應」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for analyze self-heating and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 自熱效應的原理
knowledge.text: 埋氧的熱阻可提高局部溫升。
knowledge.textEn: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋氧抑制電性耦合的同時也增加垂直熱阻，薄體電晶體的電性比較應包含自熱條件。
knowledge.textEn: Buried oxide reduces electrical coupling while adding vertical thermal resistance; thin-body comparisons should include self-heating.

selectedSteps.title: SOI 放行矩陣
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「SOI 放行矩陣」的工程驗收單，把頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the soi stack, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、薄層均勻、鍵合與熱管理需共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation, layer uniformity, bonding and thermal behavior require joint review. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「SOI 放行矩陣」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the soi stack and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: SOI 放行矩陣的原理
knowledge.text: 隔離、薄層均勻、鍵合與熱管理需共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation, layer uniformity, bonding and thermal behavior require joint review.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋氧抑制電性耦合的同時也增加垂直熱阻，薄體電晶體的電性比較應包含自熱條件。
knowledge.textEn: Buried oxide reduces electrical coupling while adding vertical thermal resistance; thin-body comparisons should include self-heating.

selectedSteps.title: 污染分類
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「污染分類」的因果圖，把去污效果、材料損失、再污染中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for classify contaminants, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 污染分類的原理
knowledge.text: 粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。
knowledge.textEn: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 去除目標可能是表面粒子、溶解金屬或反應殘留；同一粒子掃描器不能提供這三者完整證據。
knowledge.textEn: Targets may be particles, dissolved metals or reaction residues; one particle scanner cannot fully characterize all three.

selectedSteps.title: 化學選擇性
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「化學選擇性」的因果圖，把去污效果、材料損失、再污染中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess chemical selectivity, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「選擇性需同時計入污染移除及基底損失。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Selectivity includes contaminant removal and substrate loss. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高電阻率足以排除所有有機污染。 應回到「化學選擇性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High resistivity rules out every organic contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess chemical selectivity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 化學選擇性的原理
knowledge.text: 選擇性需同時計入污染移除及基底損失。
knowledge.textEn: Selectivity includes contaminant removal and substrate loss.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 表面反應後的產物仍須移出邊界層；化學反應完成不代表表面已沒有可再沉積物。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction products must leave the boundary layer; completed chemistry does not imply no redepositable material remains.

selectedSteps.title: 沖洗置換模型
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「沖洗置換模型」的因果圖，把去污效果、材料損失、再污染中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for model rinse displacement, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「沖洗置換模型」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for model rinse displacement and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 沖洗置換模型的原理
knowledge.text: 僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。
knowledge.textEn: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 乾燥時液體體積下降會濃縮不揮發物，毛細力又可能使細長結構變形，兩種失效需分開觀察。
knowledge.textEn: Drying concentrates nonvolatile residues and generates capillary deformation; these failure mechanisms need separate observations.

selectedSteps.title: 前後粒子差
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「前後粒子差」的因果圖，把去污效果、材料損失、再污染中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for calculate particle adders, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「比較必須匹配同一掃描範圍與門檻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Before-after counts need matching scan areas and thresholds. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「前後粒子差」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for calculate particle adders and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 前後粒子差的原理
knowledge.text: 比較必須匹配同一掃描範圍與門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Before-after counts need matching scan areas and thresholds.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 清潔驗收要比較污染減少與基底消耗，並確認搬運及排隊後的表面仍符合下一模組要求。
knowledge.textEn: Cleaning acceptance balances contaminant removal against substrate consumption and verifies the surface after transport and queueing.

selectedSteps.title: 潔淨交接單
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「潔淨交接單」的工程驗收單，把去污效果、材料損失、再污染中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for complete the cleanliness handoff, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「潔淨交接單」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for complete the cleanliness handoff and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 潔淨交接單的原理
knowledge.text: 移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 清潔驗收要比較污染減少與基底消耗，並確認搬運及排隊後的表面仍符合下一模組要求。
knowledge.textEn: Cleaning acceptance balances contaminant removal against substrate consumption and verifies the surface after transport and queueing.

selectedSteps.title: 界定使用點
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「界定使用點」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define points of use, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「界定使用點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define points of use and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 界定使用點的原理
knowledge.text: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。
knowledge.textEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染物質量流率為濃度乘流量；濃度相同時，大流量使用點可能接收更大的污染總量。
knowledge.textEn: Contaminant mass flow is concentration times flow, so a high-flow outlet can receive more contaminant at equal concentration.

selectedSteps.title: 前處理功能
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「前處理功能」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assign pretreatment functions, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前處理保護後段膜與樹脂，不等於末端純化。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Pretreatment protects downstream media but is not final polishing. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高電阻率足以排除所有有機污染。 應回到「前處理功能」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High resistivity rules out every organic contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assign pretreatment functions and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 前處理功能的原理
knowledge.text: 前處理保護後段膜與樹脂，不等於末端純化。
knowledge.textEn: Pretreatment protects downstream media but is not final polishing.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 反滲透、離子交換與終端過濾針對不同物種；串聯設計需要追蹤每段去除及新引入的污染。
knowledge.textEn: Reverse osmosis, ion exchange and final filtration target different species; track both removal and added contamination at every stage.

selectedSteps.title: 循環管網
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「循環管網」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace the recirculation loop, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「持續循環降低滯留但不能代替材料潔淨度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Recirculation reduces stagnation but cannot replace material cleanliness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「循環管網」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace the recirculation loop and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 循環管網的原理
knowledge.text: 持續循環降低滯留但不能代替材料潔淨度。
knowledge.textEn: Recirculation reduces stagnation but cannot replace material cleanliness.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 循環管內停留時間會把源頭事件延遲至使用點，警報回溯須把管內容積與流量納入。
knowledge.textEn: Pipe residence time delays source events at outlets; excursion tracing needs pipe volume and flow.

selectedSteps.title: 異常隔離區
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「異常隔離區」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define excursion boundaries, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「受影響晶圓需依暴露時間窗回溯。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Affected wafers should be traced through the exposure time window. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「異常隔離區」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define excursion boundaries and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 異常隔離區的原理
knowledge.text: 受影響晶圓需依暴露時間窗回溯。
knowledge.textEn: Affected wafers should be traced through the exposure time window.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 回收率提高通常降低排放體積，卻可能增加濃水負荷與純化難度，因此水量與品質需共同平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Higher recovery reduces discharge volume but can increase concentrate burden and purification difficulty, requiring joint quantity-quality balancing.

selectedSteps.title: 水務放行報告
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「水務放行報告」的工程驗收單，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for assemble water-system acceptance, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「品質、供應穩定、採樣及異常追溯須同時成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs quality, supply stability, sampling and excursion traceability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「水務放行報告」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assemble water-system acceptance and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 水務放行報告的原理
knowledge.text: 品質、供應穩定、採樣及異常追溯須同時成立。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance needs quality, supply stability, sampling and excursion traceability.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 回收率提高通常降低排放體積，卻可能增加濃水負荷與純化難度，因此水量與品質需共同平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Higher recovery reduces discharge volume but can increase concentrate burden and purification difficulty, requiring joint quantity-quality balancing.

selectedSteps.title: 建立污染源地圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「建立污染源地圖」的因果圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map contamination sources, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 建立污染源地圖的原理
knowledge.text: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。
knowledge.textEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染控制是來源、傳輸、表面沉積與器件敏感度的串聯問題；控制來源並不自動證明所有傳輸路徑已封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination links sources, transport, deposition and device sensitivity; source control does not prove all transport paths are closed.

selectedSteps.title: 氣流方向
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「氣流方向」的因果圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map airflow direction, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平均風速無法取代局部回流辨識。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean velocity does not identify local recirculation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高電阻率足以排除所有有機污染。 應回到「氣流方向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High resistivity rules out every organic contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map airflow direction and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 氣流方向的原理
knowledge.text: 平均風速無法取代局部回流辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Mean velocity does not identify local recirculation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 粒子依慣性、擴散與重力等機制移動，分子污染則另受吸附平衡與化學反應影響。
knowledge.textEn: Particles move through inertia, diffusion and gravity, while molecular contamination also involves adsorption equilibria and reactions.

selectedSteps.title: 容器浸出物
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「容器浸出物」的因果圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for audit container extractables, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「化學液潔淨度會受包材與接觸時間影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Chemical purity depends on packaging and contact duration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「容器浸出物」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for audit container extractables and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 容器浸出物的原理
knowledge.text: 化學液潔淨度會受包材與接觸時間影響。
knowledge.textEn: Chemical purity depends on packaging and contact duration.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接液材料可能釋出原有污染或吸附後再釋放；材料名稱相同仍需比較潔淨處理與接觸歷史。
knowledge.textEn: Wetted materials can release inherent or previously adsorbed contamination; identical material names do not establish equal cleaning or contact histories.

selectedSteps.title: 檢出限標示
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「檢出限標示」的因果圖，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for report detection limits, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「未檢出不等於污染濃度嚴格為零。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Nondetection does not imply exactly zero contamination. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「檢出限標示」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for report detection limits and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 檢出限標示的原理
knowledge.text: 未檢出不等於污染濃度嚴格為零。
knowledge.textEn: Nondetection does not imply exactly zero contamination.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 一個缺陷熱點可由局部來源或流場集中造成；排查須把空間分布與事件時間線一起對照。
knowledge.textEn: A defect hotspot can reflect a local source or flow concentration; compare spatial patterns with event timelines.

selectedSteps.title: 污染控制報告
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「污染控制報告」的工程驗收單，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for compile the control dossier, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「來源、傳輸、沉積與電性後果應分層呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report source, transport, deposition and electrical consequence separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「污染控制報告」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compile the control dossier and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 污染控制報告的原理
knowledge.text: 來源、傳輸、沉積與電性後果應分層呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Report source, transport, deposition and electrical consequence separately.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 一個缺陷熱點可由局部來源或流場集中造成；排查須把空間分布與事件時間線一起對照。
knowledge.textEn: A defect hotspot can reflect a local source or flow concentration; compare spatial patterns with event timelines.

selectedSteps.title: 辨識載具與批號
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「辨識載具與批號」的因果圖，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify carriers and lots, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 辨識載具與批號的原理
knowledge.text: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
knowledge.textEn: Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

selectedSteps.title: 任務狀態機
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「任務狀態機」的因果圖，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw the task state machine, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「已派工、已取貨與已送達不可合併為一個狀態。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Assigned, picked and delivered are distinct states. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：任務重試可以建立新的實體取貨而不核對狀態。 應回到「任務狀態機」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Retries can start another pickup without state reconciliation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw the task state machine and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 任務狀態機的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Draw the task state machine principle
knowledge.text: 已派工、已取貨與已送達不可合併為一個狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Assigned, picked and delivered are distinct states.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 物理移動與資訊確認可能不同步；任務識別碼及冪等重試能避免遺失回覆導致重複搬運。
knowledge.textEn: Physical movement and acknowledgement may differ in time; unique task IDs and idempotent retries prevent duplicate transport after lost replies.

selectedSteps.title: 瓶頸利用率
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「瓶頸利用率」的因果圖，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure bottleneck utilization, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高平均車速不能證明最繁忙路段不塞車。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: High average speed does not exclude congestion on a busy segment. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：已派工與已送達可使用同一狀態。 應回到「瓶頸利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Assigned and delivered can share one state. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure bottleneck utilization and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 瓶頸利用率的原理
knowledge.text: 高平均車速不能證明最繁忙路段不塞車。
knowledge.textEn: High average speed does not exclude congestion on a busy segment.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 路段利用率接近滿載時，微小到達波動可能形成長隊列；提高全廠平均車速不一定解除局部合流瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: Near-capacity segments can develop long queues under small arrival variations; faster average travel may not resolve a local merging bottleneck.

selectedSteps.title: 搬運振動
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「搬運振動」的因果圖，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess transport vibration, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「峰值加速度與振動頻譜都可能影響脆弱載荷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Peak acceleration and vibration spectra can affect fragile payloads. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：中位延遲合格就不會有嚴重逾時。 應回到「搬運振動」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: An acceptable median excludes severe timeouts. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess transport vibration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 搬運振動的原理
knowledge.text: 峰值加速度與振動頻譜都可能影響脆弱載荷。
knowledge.textEn: Peak acceleration and vibration spectra can affect fragile payloads.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 設備吞吐量、尾端等待、錯送率、振動與污染是不同驗收維度，必須在同一代表性工作負載下比較。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput, tail waits, misdelivery, vibration and contamination are distinct acceptance dimensions needing the same representative workload.

selectedSteps.title: 搬運系統驗收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「搬運系統驗收」的工程驗收單，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept the transport system, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：中位延遲合格就不會有嚴重逾時。 應回到「搬運系統驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: An acceptable median excludes severe timeouts. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept the transport system and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 搬運系統驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 設備吞吐量、尾端等待、錯送率、振動與污染是不同驗收維度，必須在同一代表性工作負載下比較。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput, tail waits, misdelivery, vibration and contamination are distinct acceptance dimensions needing the same representative workload.

selectedSteps.title: 分辨成長與沉積
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「分辨成長與沉積」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate growth and deposition, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 分辨成長與沉積的原理
knowledge.text: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

selectedSteps.title: 線性成長區
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「線性成長區」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify the linear regime, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「薄層成長可能主要受界面反應限制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thin-film growth can be mainly interface-reaction limited. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「線性成長區」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the linear regime and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 線性成長區的原理
knowledge.text: 薄層成長可能主要受界面反應限制。
knowledge.textEn: Thin-film growth can be mainly interface-reaction limited.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: Deal–Grove 型關係把界面反應與氧化劑穿越氧化層的傳輸串接；極薄層需另檢查模型偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Deal–Grove-type relations combine interface reaction and oxidant transport through oxide; ultrathin films require additional model checks.

selectedSteps.title: 橢偏膜厚
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「橢偏膜厚」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for interpret ellipsometric thickness, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「光學膜厚反演需要折射率與堆疊假設。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「橢偏膜厚」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret ellipsometric thickness and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 橢偏膜厚的原理
knowledge.text: 光學膜厚反演需要折射率與堆疊假設。
knowledge.textEn: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 電容量測反映電性有效堆疊，光學量測依賴折射率模型，兩者一致性可用來檢查介面層假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capacitance reflects an electrical stack while optical measurements depend on refractive-index models; agreement can test interfacial-layer assumptions.

selectedSteps.title: 熱預算累加
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「熱預算累加」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for accumulate thermal history, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「熱預算累加」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accumulate thermal history and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 熱預算累加的原理
knowledge.text: 長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。
knowledge.textEn: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 氧化也消耗熱預算並改變摻雜輪廓，因此合格氧化層仍可能造成鄰近接面或短通道指標變差。
knowledge.textEn: Oxidation consumes thermal budget and alters dopant profiles, so an acceptable oxide can coexist with degraded junction or short-channel behavior.

selectedSteps.title: 閘氧驗收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「閘氧驗收」的工程驗收單，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept the gate oxide, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「厚度圖、介面、漏電與可靠度缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「閘氧驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept the gate oxide and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 閘氧驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 厚度圖、介面、漏電與可靠度缺一不可。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 氧化也消耗熱預算並改變摻雜輪廓，因此合格氧化層仍可能造成鄰近接面或短通道指標變差。
knowledge.textEn: Oxidation consumes thermal budget and alters dopant profiles, so an acceptable oxide can coexist with degraded junction or short-channel behavior.

title: 高介電常數原子層沉積

selectedSteps.title: 物理厚度與 EOT
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「物理厚度與 EOT」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate thickness and eot, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「物理厚度與 EOT」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate thickness and eot and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 物理厚度與 EOT的原理
knowledge.text: 較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。
knowledge.textEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 串聯介電層滿足電容倒數相加；若介面層電容較小，單純提高上層介電常數的整體收益有限。
knowledge.textEn: Series capacitances add inversely; a small interfacial capacitance limits benefits from raising the upper-layer permittivity.

selectedSteps.title: 第一半反應
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「第一半反應」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace the first half-reaction, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「飽和吸附後增加暴露不應無限增加單循環成長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: After saturation, exposure should not indefinitely increase cycle growth. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「第一半反應」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace the first half-reaction and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 第一半反應的原理
knowledge.text: 飽和吸附後增加暴露不應無限增加單循環成長。
knowledge.textEn: After saturation, exposure should not indefinitely increase cycle growth.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: ALD 的自限制反應需以暴露飽和證據確認；觀察到循環成長不等於已排除氣相 CVD 成分。
knowledge.textEn: ALD self-limitation needs exposure-saturation evidence; cyclic growth alone does not rule out a gas-phase CVD contribution.

selectedSteps.title: 深槽反應物耗盡
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「深槽反應物耗盡」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess feature-scale depletion, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「入口飽和不代表高深寬比底部已飽和。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Entrance saturation does not prove bottom saturation in deep features. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「深槽反應物耗盡」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess feature-scale depletion and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 深槽反應物耗盡的原理
knowledge.text: 入口飽和不代表高深寬比底部已飽和。
knowledge.textEn: Entrance saturation does not prove bottom saturation in deep features.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 狹窄特徵增加表面積與反應物消耗，入口暴露充分時，深處仍可能需要更長的傳輸時間。
knowledge.textEn: Narrow features increase surface area and reactant demand, so deep regions can require longer transport even with adequate entrance exposure.

selectedSteps.title: 介面偶極
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「介面偶極」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace interface dipoles, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「介面偶極」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace interface dipoles and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 介面偶極的原理
knowledge.text: 介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。
knowledge.textEn: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低 EOT、低漏電及低陷阱密度是不同目標；改變介面處理可能改善其中一項卻犧牲另一項。
knowledge.textEn: Low EOT, leakage and trap density are distinct objectives; an interface treatment may improve one while compromising another.

selectedSteps.title: 高介電層放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「高介電層放行」的工程驗收單，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the high-k layer, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「高介電層放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the high-k layer and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 高介電層放行的原理
knowledge.text: EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低 EOT、低漏電及低陷阱密度是不同目標；改變介面處理可能改善其中一項卻犧牲另一項。
knowledge.textEn: Low EOT, leakage and trap density are distinct objectives; an interface treatment may improve one while compromising another.

selectedSteps.title: 定義真空功函數
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「定義真空功函數」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define vacuum work function, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
