selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 定義真空功函數的原理
knowledge.text: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 平帶及閾值由金屬、介電層、半導體與電荷共同決定，不能用單一金屬真空功函數直接替代整個堆疊。
knowledge.textEn: Flat-band and threshold depend on metal, dielectric, semiconductor and charge; vacuum work function cannot replace the whole stack.

selectedSteps.title: 薄金屬連續性
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「薄金屬連續性」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess thin-metal continuity, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「極薄金屬可能未形成連續覆蓋。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: An ultrathin metal layer may not be continuous. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「薄金屬連續性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess thin-metal continuity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 薄金屬連續性的原理
knowledge.text: 極薄金屬可能未形成連續覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An ultrathin metal layer may not be continuous.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 超薄功函數層可能受成核、晶粒及介面反應影響；材料化學式相同不代表局部有效功函數相同。
knowledge.textEn: Ultrathin work-function layers depend on nucleation, grains and reactions; equal formulas do not ensure equal local effective work function.

selectedSteps.title: 區域保護層
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「區域保護層」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for plan regional protection, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「選擇處理一種元件時需保護另一種閘堆疊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Processing one device polarity requires protecting the other stack. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「區域保護層」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for plan regional protection and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 區域保護層的原理
knowledge.text: 選擇處理一種元件時需保護另一種閘堆疊。
knowledge.textEn: Processing one device polarity requires protecting the other stack.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 狹窄閘腔的厚度總和受幾何約束，增加一層材料會減少其他層可用空間並可能形成空洞。
knowledge.textEn: A narrow gate cavity limits total stack thickness; adding one layer reduces space for others and can promote voids.

selectedSteps.title: C-V 與 I-V
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「C-V 與 I-V」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for cross-check c-v and i-v, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「兩種量測對介面與通道的敏感度不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: C-V and I-V have different interface and channel sensitivities. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「C-V 與 I-V」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for cross-check c-v and i-v and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: C-V 與 I-V的原理
knowledge.text: 兩種量測對介面與通道的敏感度不同。
knowledge.textEn: C-V and I-V have different interface and channel sensitivities.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 製程造成的初始閾值偏移與偏壓老化漂移需分開記錄，才能判斷改良來自材料設定還是可靠度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Separate initial process-induced threshold shifts from bias-aging drift to distinguish material tuning from reliability changes.

selectedSteps.title: 金屬閘極驗收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「金屬閘極驗收」的工程驗收單，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept the metal gate, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「金屬閘極驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept the metal gate and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 金屬閘極驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 製程造成的初始閾值偏移與偏壓老化漂移需分開記錄，才能判斷改良來自材料設定還是可靠度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Separate initial process-induced threshold shifts from bias-aging drift to distinguish material tuning from reliability changes.

selectedSteps.title: 劑量與濃度
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「劑量與濃度」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate dose and concentration, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 劑量與濃度的原理
knowledge.text: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

selectedSteps.title: 質量分析
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「質量分析」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace mass selection, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「電荷質量比選擇有助區分束流物種。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mass-to-charge selection helps distinguish beam species. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：片電阻下降就證明接面完全無損傷。 應回到「質量分析」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower sheet resistance proves a damage-free junction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace mass selection and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 質量分析的原理
knowledge.text: 電荷質量比選擇有助區分束流物種。
knowledge.textEn: Mass-to-charge selection helps distinguish beam species.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶體通道效應與圖案遮蔽是不同方向性問題；改變佈植角度時需同時檢查兩者。
knowledge.textEn: Crystal channeling and pattern shadowing are different directional problems; changing implant angle requires evaluating both.

selectedSteps.title: 碰撞損傷
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「碰撞損傷」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map collision damage, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「佈植後的化學濃度不代表可用載子濃度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Post-implant chemical concentration is not active carrier concentration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「碰撞損傷」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map collision damage and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 碰撞損傷的原理
knowledge.text: 佈植後的化學濃度不代表可用載子濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Post-implant chemical concentration is not active carrier concentration.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 佈植造成的空位及間隙原子會在退火中演化，活化與暫態擴散不能只由初始化學濃度預測。
knowledge.textEn: Implant vacancies and interstitials evolve during annealing; activation and transient diffusion cannot follow from initial chemical concentration alone.

selectedSteps.title: SIMS 深度校準
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「SIMS 深度校準」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for calibrate sims depth, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「濺鍍時間轉深度需材料相關校準。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Converting sputter time to depth needs material-dependent calibration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「SIMS 深度校準」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for calibrate sims depth and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: SIMS 深度校準的原理
knowledge.text: 濺鍍時間轉深度需材料相關校準。
knowledge.textEn: Converting sputter time to depth needs material-dependent calibration.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: SIMS 提供化學輪廓，電性量測反映活化載子與遷移率；兩種資料的深度及面積需一致才能比較。
knowledge.textEn: SIMS gives chemical profiles while electrical measurements reflect active carriers and mobility; align depth and area before comparing.

selectedSteps.title: 佈植批次審查
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「佈植批次審查」的工程驗收單，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review the implant lot, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「劑量、深度、均勻、損傷及活化缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review dose, depth, uniformity, damage and activation together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「佈植批次審查」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review the implant lot and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 佈植批次審查的原理
knowledge.text: 劑量、深度、均勻、損傷及活化缺一不可。
knowledge.textEn: Review dose, depth, uniformity, damage and activation together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: SIMS 提供化學輪廓，電性量測反映活化載子與遷移率；兩種資料的深度及面積需一致才能比較。
knowledge.textEn: SIMS gives chemical profiles while electrical measurements reflect active carriers and mobility; align depth and area before comparing.

selectedSteps.title: 活化與擴散
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「活化與擴散」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate activation and diffusion, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「活化與擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate activation and diffusion and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 活化與擴散的原理
knowledge.text: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 擴散長度與時間積分的擴散係數相關，因此短而熱與長而冷的處理不能只用最高溫度排序。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion length relates to integrated diffusivity, so short-hot and long-cool cycles cannot be ranked by peak temperature alone.

selectedSteps.title: 燈區分配
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「燈區分配」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for allocate heating zones, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「多區加熱需要處理區域之間的熱耦合。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Multizone heating must account for thermal coupling. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：片電阻下降就證明接面完全無損傷。 應回到「燈區分配」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower sheet resistance proves a damage-free junction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for allocate heating zones and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 燈區分配的原理
knowledge.text: 多區加熱需要處理區域之間的熱耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Multizone heating must account for thermal coupling.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 高溫計將光輻射轉為溫度時需要發射率模型；表面堆疊不同會改變同一訊號的解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Pyrometry converts radiance to temperature using emissivity; different surface stacks change interpretation of the same signal.

selectedSteps.title: 片電阻前後
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「片電阻前後」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare sheet resistance, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片電阻下降需與接面深度同時比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Reduced sheet resistance should be assessed with junction depth. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「片電阻前後」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare sheet resistance and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 片電阻前後的原理
knowledge.text: 片電阻下降需與接面深度同時比較。
knowledge.textEn: Reduced sheet resistance should be assessed with junction depth.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 活化改善可降低片電阻，但缺陷引起的接面漏電可能仍存在；兩者需以獨立結構量測。
knowledge.textEn: Activation can reduce sheet resistance while defect-induced junction leakage remains; measure both using independent structures.

selectedSteps.title: 峰值與停留權衡
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「峰值與停留權衡」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trade peak temperature against dwell, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「更短停留不能無條件抵銷更高峰值的所有效應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Shorter dwell does not universally cancel all effects of higher peaks. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「峰值與停留權衡」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trade peak temperature against dwell and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 峰值與停留權衡的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Trade peak temperature against dwell principle
knowledge.text: 更短停留不能無條件抵銷更高峰值的所有效應。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter dwell does not universally cancel all effects of higher peaks.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 退火窗口是活化、擴散及材料耐受的交集，不能只選片電阻最低的條件當作整合最佳值。
knowledge.textEn: The anneal window intersects activation, diffusion and material survival; minimum sheet resistance alone is not an integrated optimum.

selectedSteps.title: 退火窗口放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「退火窗口放行」的工程驗收單，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept the annealing window, connecting relevant limits in temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化、擴散、漏電及結構損傷需共同滿足。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation, diffusion, leakage and structural damage must all meet criteria. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「退火窗口放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept the annealing window and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 退火窗口放行的原理
knowledge.text: 活化、擴散、漏電及結構損傷需共同滿足。
knowledge.textEn: Activation, diffusion, leakage and structural damage must all meet criteria.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 退火窗口是活化、擴散及材料耐受的交集，不能只選片電阻最低的條件當作整合最佳值。
knowledge.textEn: The anneal window intersects activation, diffusion and material survival; minimum sheet resistance alone is not an integrated optimum.

selectedSteps.title: 毫秒與奈秒
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「毫秒與奈秒」的因果圖，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「毫秒與奈秒」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 毫秒與奈秒的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes principle
knowledge.text: 不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。
knowledge.textEn: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 熱擴散尺度約與時間平方根成正比；縮短熱脈衝可減少深部受熱，但表面溫度仍需量測。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal diffusion length scales roughly with square-root time; shorter pulses reduce deep heating but still require surface thermometry.

selectedSteps.title: 光斑強度剖面
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「光斑強度剖面」的因果圖，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for read the beam profile, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平均功率不能代表光斑內局部強度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean power does not describe local beam intensity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：片電阻下降就證明接面完全無損傷。 應回到「光斑強度剖面」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower sheet resistance proves a damage-free junction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for read the beam profile and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 光斑強度剖面的原理
knowledge.text: 平均功率不能代表光斑內局部強度。
knowledge.textEn: Mean power does not describe local beam intensity.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 固定光斑寬度時，停留時間約為寬度除以掃速；重疊區的累積歷程還需把相鄰掃描相加。
knowledge.textEn: For a fixed beam width, dwell is roughly width divided by speed; overlap history also includes adjacent scans.

selectedSteps.title: 摻雜活化
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「摻雜活化」的因果圖，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for evaluate dopant activation, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「短熱歷程可改變活化與擴散的相對程度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Short thermal histories change the balance between activation and diffusion. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「摻雜活化」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for evaluate dopant activation and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 摻雜活化的原理
knowledge.text: 短熱歷程可改變活化與擴散的相對程度。
knowledge.textEn: Short thermal histories change the balance between activation and diffusion.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 吸收能量轉為溫升要考慮熱容量、熱擴散與可能相變，因此入射能量不能直接當作局部最高溫。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature rise depends on heat capacity, diffusion and possible phase changes; incident energy is not local peak temperature.

selectedSteps.title: 金屬圖案吸收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「金屬圖案吸收」的因果圖，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare patterned absorption, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「反射率差異使不同區塊接受不同熱負荷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Reflectivity variations give different blocks different thermal loads. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「金屬圖案吸收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare patterned absorption and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 金屬圖案吸收的原理
knowledge.text: 反射率差異使不同區塊接受不同熱負荷。
knowledge.textEn: Reflectivity variations give different blocks different thermal loads.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 金屬與介電圖案的反射及吸收不同，代表性驗證應包含圖案晶圓而非僅有裸矽校準片。
knowledge.textEn: Metal and dielectric patterns differ optically, so representative validation needs patterned wafers beyond bare-silicon calibration.

selectedSteps.title: 雷射退火審查
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「雷射退火審查」的工程驗收單，把光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review laser-anneal evidence, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化收益需與熱峰值、均勻性及下層相容性一起評估。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Assess activation gain with thermal peaks, uniformity and buried-layer compatibility. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「雷射退火審查」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review laser-anneal evidence and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 雷射退火審查的原理
knowledge.text: 活化收益需與熱峰值、均勻性及下層相容性一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: Assess activation gain with thermal peaks, uniformity and buried-layer compatibility.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 金屬與介電圖案的反射及吸收不同，代表性驗證應包含圖案晶圓而非僅有裸矽校準片。
knowledge.textEn: Metal and dielectric patterns differ optically, so representative validation needs patterned wafers beyond bare-silicon calibration.

selectedSteps.title: 批次位置圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「批次位置圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map batch positions, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「批次位置圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map batch positions and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 批次位置圖的原理
knowledge.text: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。
knowledge.textEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

selectedSteps.title: 加熱區校準
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「加熱區校準」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for calibrate heating zones, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「各區控制需要考慮相鄰區熱耦合。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Zone control requires adjacent-zone thermal coupling. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：片電阻下降就證明接面完全無損傷。 應回到「加熱區校準」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower sheet resistance proves a damage-free junction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for calibrate heating zones and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 加熱區校準的原理
knowledge.text: 各區控制需要考慮相鄰區熱耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Zone control requires adjacent-zone thermal coupling.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶舟和晶圓增加熱容量，也改變氣流與熱輻射遮蔽，因此空爐校準須經負載條件驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Boats and wafers add thermal mass and change flow and radiation shielding; empty-furnace calibration needs loaded verification.

selectedSteps.title: Fick 通量方向
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「Fick 通量方向」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw fickian flux, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「擴散通量由濃度梯度而不是濃度本身決定。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Diffusion flux depends on concentration gradient rather than concentration alone. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「Fick 通量方向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw fickian flux and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: Fick 通量方向的原理
knowledge.text: 擴散通量由濃度梯度而不是濃度本身決定。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion flux depends on concentration gradient rather than concentration alone.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: Fick 模型的通量取決於梯度，均勻高濃度區可有低通量，而低濃度但陡梯度區可有顯著通量。
knowledge.textEn: Fickian flux follows gradients: uniform high concentration can have little flux while a low but steep profile can have substantial flux.

selectedSteps.title: 徑向與軸向圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「徑向與軸向圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「徑向與軸向圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate radial and axial maps and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 徑向與軸向圖的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate radial and axial maps principle
knowledge.text: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。
knowledge.textEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

selectedSteps.title: 批次擴散驗收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「批次擴散驗收」的工程驗收單，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept batch diffusion, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「批次擴散驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept batch diffusion and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 批次擴散驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。
knowledge.textEn: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

selectedSteps.title: 主動區邊界
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「主動區邊界」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw active-area boundaries, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「主動區邊界」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 主動區邊界的原理
knowledge.text: 隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 隔離必須在截面上切斷非預期導通路徑，溝槽名稱或深度單一數值無法完整描述電性隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation must interrupt unintended conduction paths in section; a trench label or single depth cannot fully describe it.

selectedSteps.title: 溝槽側壁角
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「溝槽側壁角」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure trench sidewall angle, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「溝槽側壁角」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure trench sidewall angle and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 溝槽側壁角的原理
knowledge.text: 側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 側壁形狀與襯層消耗會改變填充前的實際開口，所以設計圖寬度不能直接代替沉積入口寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape and liner consumption change the prefill opening, so layout width is not necessarily deposition-entry width.

selectedSteps.title: 底部與側壁成長
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「底部與側壁成長」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare bottom and sidewall growth, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不均勻成長可能造成入口先封閉。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Uneven growth can close the opening prematurely. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「底部與側壁成長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare bottom and sidewall growth and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 底部與側壁成長的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Compare bottom and sidewall growth principle
knowledge.text: 不均勻成長可能造成入口先封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven growth can close the opening prematurely.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 填充空洞是內部缺陷，CMP 凹陷是表面形貌；兩者可同時存在，需截面與表面量測各自確認。
knowledge.textEn: Fill voids are internal defects while CMP recess is surface topography; both may coexist and need separate measurements.

selectedSteps.title: 窄寬效應
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「窄寬效應」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess narrow-width effects, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「通道靠近隔離邊界時邊緣影響比例增加。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Edge effects become proportionally larger near isolation boundaries. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「窄寬效應」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess narrow-width effects and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 窄寬效應的原理
knowledge.text: 通道靠近隔離邊界時邊緣影響比例增加。
knowledge.textEn: Edge effects become proportionally larger near isolation boundaries.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: STI 應力可依主動區到隔離邊界的距離改變元件特性，因此驗收需涵蓋版圖而不只是材料樣片。
knowledge.textEn: STI stress can change devices with distance to isolation; acceptance therefore needs layout coverage beyond material coupons.

selectedSteps.title: STI 整合放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「STI 整合放行」的工程驗收單，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept sti integration, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「填充、平坦、漏電與通道應力需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「STI 整合放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept sti integration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: STI 整合放行的原理
knowledge.text: 填充、平坦、漏電與通道應力需共同符合要求。
knowledge.textEn: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: STI 應力可依主動區到隔離邊界的距離改變元件特性，因此驗收需涵蓋版圖而不只是材料樣片。
knowledge.textEn: STI stress can change devices with distance to isolation; acceptance therefore needs layout coverage beyond material coupons.

selectedSteps.title: 應力與應變
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「應力與應變」的因果圖，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate stress and strain, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 應力與應變的原理
knowledge.text: 應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。
knowledge.textEn: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 應變對輸運的作用依賴方向、載子及能帶；「增加應力」沒有脫離方向與材料的普遍正面意義。
knowledge.textEn: Strain effects depend on direction, carriers and bands; increasing stress has no universal benefit independent of material and direction.

selectedSteps.title: 嵌入式源汲極
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「嵌入式源汲極」的因果圖，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace embedded stressors, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「源汲極材料晶格差可透過拘束把應力傳入通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Source-drain lattice mismatch can transfer stress into a constrained channel. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「嵌入式源汲極」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace embedded stressors and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 嵌入式源汲極的原理
knowledge.text: 源汲極材料晶格差可透過拘束把應力傳入通道。
knowledge.textEn: Source-drain lattice mismatch can transfer stress into a constrained channel.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶格失配可先以彈性形變承受，超出可維持範圍後可能藉位錯鬆弛，必須同看應變與缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Lattice mismatch can remain elastic before relaxing through dislocations; inspect strain and defects together.

selectedSteps.title: 拉曼位移
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「拉曼位移」的因果圖，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for interpret raman shifts, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「峰位變化也需排除溫度及成分影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Peak shifts require separating temperature and composition effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「拉曼位移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret raman shifts and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 拉曼位移的原理
knowledge.text: 峰位變化也需排除溫度及成分影響。
knowledge.textEn: Peak shifts require separating temperature and composition effects.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 實際量測具有有限空間平均範圍，模擬的單點峰值需經相同空間平均才適合與量測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements have finite spatial averaging; simulated point peaks need equivalent averaging before comparison.

selectedSteps.title: 有效遷移率
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「有效遷移率」的因果圖，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for extract effective mobility, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「抽取結果需控制閘電容與串聯電阻假設。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Extraction depends on gate-capacitance and series-resistance assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「有效遷移率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for extract effective mobility and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 有效遷移率的原理
knowledge.text: 抽取結果需控制閘電容與串聯電阻假設。
knowledge.textEn: Extraction depends on gate-capacitance and series-resistance assumptions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
knowledge.textEn: Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

selectedSteps.title: 應變整合結論
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「應變整合結論」的工程驗收單，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review strain integration, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「應變整合結論」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review strain integration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 應變整合結論的原理
knowledge.text: 需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
knowledge.textEn: Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

selectedSteps.title: 選擇性定義
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「選擇性定義」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define selectivity, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「選擇性定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define selectivity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 選擇性定義的原理
knowledge.text: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

selectedSteps.title: 表面前清潔
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「表面前清潔」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess pre-epitaxy cleaning, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「清潔需移除阻礙物而保留種晶幾何。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Cleaning must remove barriers while preserving seed geometry. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「表面前清潔」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess pre-epitaxy cleaning and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 表面前清潔的原理
knowledge.text: 清潔需移除阻礙物而保留種晶幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Cleaning must remove barriers while preserving seed geometry.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶面速度不同造成外形演化，圖案密度又改變局部供料，因此截面形貌不能只由沉積時間決定。
knowledge.textEn: Facet-dependent rates and pattern-dependent supply govern shape, so deposition time alone cannot determine the section.

selectedSteps.title: 鍺深度分布
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「鍺深度分布」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map germanium depth profiles, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「表面平均成分不能代表整層成分梯度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean surface composition cannot represent a depth gradient. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「鍺深度分布」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map germanium depth profiles and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 鍺深度分布的原理
knowledge.text: 表面平均成分不能代表整層成分梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Mean surface composition cannot represent a depth gradient.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鍺比例、活化與晶格鬆弛相互耦合；更高名義摻雜或成分不保證更低接觸電阻及更低漏電。
knowledge.textEn: Germanium fraction, activation and relaxation interact; higher nominal doping or composition does not guarantee lower contact resistance or leakage.

selectedSteps.title: 接觸金屬反應
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「接觸金屬反應」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess metal reaction, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接觸形成後的界面成分可能不同於原磊晶表面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The contact interface can differ from the original epitaxial surface. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「接觸金屬反應」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess metal reaction and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 接觸金屬反應的原理
knowledge.text: 接觸形成後的界面成分可能不同於原磊晶表面。
knowledge.textEn: The contact interface can differ from the original epitaxial surface.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片源汲極不只提供載子，也把機械應力與電流接入多層通道，需檢查逐層端點連接。
knowledge.textEn: Nanosheet source-drain provides carriers, stress and current to several channels, requiring per-layer endpoint connectivity checks.

selectedSteps.title: SiGe 模組交接
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「SiGe 模組交接」的工程驗收單，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for complete the sige handoff, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「選擇性、活化、應變與接觸需求需共同驗收。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Accept selectivity, activation, strain and contact requirements jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「SiGe 模組交接」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for complete the sige handoff and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: SiGe 模組交接的原理
knowledge.text: 選擇性、活化、應變與接觸需求需共同驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Accept selectivity, activation, strain and contact requirements jointly.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片源汲極不只提供載子，也把機械應力與電流接入多層通道，需檢查逐層端點連接。
knowledge.textEn: Nanosheet source-drain provides carriers, stress and current to several channels, requiring per-layer endpoint connectivity checks.

title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合

selectedSteps.title: 互補反相器
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「互補反相器」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw a complementary inverter, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「互補反相器」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 互補反相器的原理
knowledge.text: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。
knowledge.textEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 反相器功能來自互補拉高與拉低路徑，井與本體接點則協助維持電位及抑制寄生作用。
knowledge.textEn: An inverter uses complementary pull-up and pull-down paths, while wells and body ties maintain potentials and suppress parasitics.

selectedSteps.title: 閘介電層
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「閘介電層」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess gate dielectric, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘電容、漏電與可靠度是不同需求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Gate capacitance, leakage and reliability are distinct needs. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「閘介電層」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess gate dielectric and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 閘介電層的原理
knowledge.text: 閘電容、漏電與可靠度是不同需求。
knowledge.textEn: Gate capacitance, leakage and reliability are distinct needs.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 側壁間隔使源汲極處理與閘邊緣形成幾何關聯，但橫向擴散仍會改變電性有效通道長度。
knowledge.textEn: Spacers geometrically relate junction processing to gate edges, but lateral diffusion still changes electrical channel length.

selectedSteps.title: 矽化物形成
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「矽化物形成」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess silicide formation, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「導電接觸反應也會消耗表面矽。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Conductive contact reactions also consume surface silicon. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「矽化物形成」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess silicide formation and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 矽化物形成的原理
knowledge.text: 導電接觸反應也會消耗表面矽。
knowledge.textEn: Conductive contact reactions also consume surface silicon.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接觸與互連把元件接成電路；元件 I-V 合格仍可能因開路、短路或過高寄生而無法工作。
knowledge.textEn: Contacts and interconnects form the circuit; good device I-V can coexist with circuit failure from opens, shorts or parasitics.

selectedSteps.title: 轉移特性
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「轉移特性」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for read inverter transfer curves, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切換點取決於兩種元件的相對驅動能力。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Switching point depends on relative device strengths. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「轉移特性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for read inverter transfer curves and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 轉移特性的原理
knowledge.text: 切換點取決於兩種元件的相對驅動能力。
knowledge.textEn: Switching point depends on relative device strengths.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 負載電容充放電需要有限電流；延遲改善須同時考慮驅動、負載、電壓及切換條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite current charges load capacitance; delay improvements depend on drive, load, voltage and switching conditions.

selectedSteps.title: 整合流程審查
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「整合流程審查」的工程驗收單，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review the integrated flow, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「步驟可單獨合格仍可能在相互作用後失敗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Individually acceptable steps can fail through integration interactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「整合流程審查」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review the integrated flow and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 整合流程審查的原理
knowledge.text: 步驟可單獨合格仍可能在相互作用後失敗。
knowledge.textEn: Individually acceptable steps can fail through integration interactions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 負載電容充放電需要有限電流；延遲改善須同時考慮驅動、負載、電壓及切換條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite current charges load capacitance; delay improvements depend on drive, load, voltage and switching conditions.

selectedSteps.title: 三面閘控制
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「三面閘控制」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw three-sided gate control, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「三面閘控制」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw three-sided gate control and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 三面閘控制的原理
knowledge.text: 閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。
knowledge.textEn: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 對近矩形鰭，三面控制的幾何寬度約隨兩倍鰭高加鰭寬改變；實際電性還受各面遷移率影響。
knowledge.textEn: For a near-rectangular fin, geometric gated width scales roughly as twice height plus width; face-dependent mobility also matters.

selectedSteps.title: 鰭圖案轉移
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「鰭圖案轉移」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for track fin pattern transfer, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭圖案轉移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track fin pattern transfer and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 鰭圖案轉移的原理
knowledge.text: 硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。
knowledge.textEn: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鰭寬、側壁角與隔離回蝕高度共同定義通道截面，三者量測應配準到同一位置。
knowledge.textEn: Fin width, taper and isolation recess jointly define the channel section and need co-registered measurements.

selectedSteps.title: 三維介電覆蓋
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「三維介電覆蓋」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess 3d dielectric coverage, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「三維介電覆蓋」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess 3d dielectric coverage and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 三維介電覆蓋的原理
knowledge.text: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 三維閘堆疊增加側壁及角落界面，單一平面監控片不能完全代表成核、覆蓋與填充。
knowledge.textEn: Three-dimensional gates add sidewall and corner interfaces; one planar monitor cannot fully represent nucleation, coverage and fill.

selectedSteps.title: 鰭高統計
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「鰭高統計」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for analyze fin-height distributions, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平均鰭高不足以評估局部驅動差異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean fin height is insufficient for local drive variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「鰭高統計」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for analyze fin-height distributions and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 鰭高統計的原理
knowledge.text: 平均鰭高不足以評估局部驅動差異。
knowledge.textEn: Mean fin height is insufficient for local drive variation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鰭數是整數，所以標準元件驅動尺寸不是任意連續變數；元件庫需把此量化與配線限制一起設計。
knowledge.textEn: Fin count is integer, so cell drive is not continuously adjustable; libraries must combine this quantization with routing constraints.

selectedSteps.title: FinFET 整合驗收
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「FinFET 整合驗收」的工程驗收單，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept finfet integration, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「靜電、電阻、變異與標準元件效能需一起審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review electrostatics, resistance, variability and cell performance jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「FinFET 整合驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept finfet integration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: FinFET 整合驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 靜電、電阻、變異與標準元件效能需一起審查。
knowledge.textEn: Review electrostatics, resistance, variability and cell performance jointly.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鰭數是整數，所以標準元件驅動尺寸不是任意連續變數；元件庫需把此量化與配線限制一起設計。
knowledge.textEn: Fin count is integer, so cell drive is not continuously adjustable; libraries must combine this quantization with routing constraints.

title: 環繞閘極奈米片電晶體

selectedSteps.title: 環繞閘拓撲
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「環繞閘拓撲」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw the gate-all-around topology, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「環繞閘拓撲」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw the gate-all-around topology and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 環繞閘拓撲的原理
knowledge.text: 閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。
knowledge.textEn: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
knowledge.textEn: Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

selectedSteps.title: 源汲極凹槽
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「源汲極凹槽」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define source-drain recess, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「源汲極凹槽」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define source-drain recess and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 源汲極凹槽的原理
knowledge.text: 凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。
knowledge.textEn: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 內間隔在源汲極與可移除犧牲層間提供保護，使後續釋放能避免破壞電流進入端。
knowledge.textEn: Inner spacers protect the source-drain from removable sacrificial layers, preserving current-entry regions during release.

selectedSteps.title: 犧牲層選蝕
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「犧牲層選蝕」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「犧牲層選蝕」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 犧牲層選蝕的原理
knowledge.text: 需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。
knowledge.textEn: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 釋放讓通道失去原先的連續支撐，也暴露更多表面；機械穩定與表面損傷需要同步驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Release removes continuous support and exposes more surface, requiring simultaneous checks of mechanical stability and surface damage.

selectedSteps.title: 每層電性差
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「每層電性差」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess per-sheet differences, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「總電流合格可能掩蓋某一層失效。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable total current can hide one failed layer. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「每層電性差」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess per-sheet differences and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 每層電性差的原理
knowledge.text: 總電流合格可能掩蓋某一層失效。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable total current can hide one failed layer.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 總電流是多片通道貢獻之和，因此單片退化可能被其他通道遮蔽；需要逐層或敏感測試結構。
knowledge.textEn: Total current sums sheet contributions, so other sheets can mask one degraded channel; use per-layer or sensitive test structures.

selectedSteps.title: GAA 整合審查
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「GAA 整合審查」的工程驗收單，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review gaa integration, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「須同時交付釋放、覆蓋、接觸與變異證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Provide release, coverage, contact and variability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「GAA 整合審查」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review gaa integration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: GAA 整合審查的原理
knowledge.text: 須同時交付釋放、覆蓋、接觸與變異證據。
knowledge.textEn: Provide release, coverage, contact and variability evidence together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 總電流是多片通道貢獻之和，因此單片退化可能被其他通道遮蔽；需要逐層或敏感測試結構。
knowledge.textEn: Total current sums sheet contributions, so other sheets can mask one degraded channel; use per-layer or sensitive test structures.

title: 互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程

selectedSteps.title: 垂直互補配置
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「垂直互補配置」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw vertical complementary stacking, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「垂直互補配置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw vertical complementary stacking and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 垂直互補配置的原理
knowledge.text: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。
knowledge.textEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
knowledge.textEn: CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

selectedSteps.title: 中介層角色
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「中介層角色」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assign middle-layer function, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「中介介電層隔離上下閘而非代替全部元件隔離。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Middle dielectric isolates tier gates rather than all device isolation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「中介層角色」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assign middle-layer function and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 中介層角色的原理
knowledge.text: 中介介電層隔離上下閘而非代替全部元件隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Middle dielectric isolates tier gates rather than all device isolation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 中介隔離讓上下閘可具有不同材料與閾值設定；其形成順序又會影響後續源汲極的可達性。
knowledge.textEn: Middle isolation supports different tier-gate materials and thresholds; its sequence also affects source-drain accessibility.

selectedSteps.title: 前側底層接觸
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「前側底層接觸」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace frontside bottom contacts, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「底層接觸需穿越或繞過上層結構。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Bottom contacts from the front must pass or bypass upper structures. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「前側底層接觸」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace frontside bottom contacts and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 前側底層接觸的原理
knowledge.text: 底層接觸需穿越或繞過上層結構。
knowledge.textEn: Bottom contacts from the front must pass or bypass upper structures.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 底層前側接觸與背側接觸各有不同加工模組，不能只比較導線長度而忽略隔離及薄化成本。
knowledge.textEn: Frontside and backside bottom contacts need different modules; wire-length comparisons alone miss isolation and thinning costs.

selectedSteps.title: 分層 I-V 測試
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「分層 I-V 測試」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for test tier-resolved i-v, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「只有合併輸出無法確認每層獨立功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「分層 I-V 測試」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for test tier-resolved i-v and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 分層 I-V 測試的原理
knowledge.text: 只有合併輸出無法確認每層獨立功能。
knowledge.textEn: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 研究測試車展示功能後，仍需更多樣本驗證變異、存活率與可靠度，才能建立製造成熟度證據。
knowledge.textEn: After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

selectedSteps.title: CFET 證據地圖
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「CFET 證據地圖」的工程驗收單，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for assemble a cfet evidence map, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「CFET 證據地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assemble a cfet evidence map and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: CFET 證據地圖的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Assemble a CFET evidence map principle
knowledge.text: 隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。
knowledge.textEn: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 研究測試車展示功能後，仍需更多樣本驗證變異、存活率與可靠度，才能建立製造成熟度證據。
knowledge.textEn: After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

selectedSteps.title: 電源與訊號分離
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「電源與訊號分離」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate power and signals, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 電源與訊號分離的原理
knowledge.text: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。
knowledge.textEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋入軌是一種局部供電結構；電源從正面或背面進入是另一個設計維度，需以完整回路判定。
knowledge.textEn: A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

selectedSteps.title: 隔離溝槽
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「隔離溝槽」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw isolation trenches, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「電源金屬需與不應導通的矽區隔離。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Power metal must be isolated from unintended silicon connections. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「隔離溝槽」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw isolation trenches and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 隔離溝槽的原理
knowledge.text: 電源金屬需與不應導通的矽區隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Power metal must be isolated from unintended silicon connections.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 金屬截面縮小提高電流密度，襯層則減少可用導體面積；幾何與隔離預算需聯合評估。
knowledge.textEn: Smaller metal cross-sections increase current density, while liners reduce usable conductor area; assess geometry and isolation together.

selectedSteps.title: 軌接觸落點
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「軌接觸落點」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for place rail contacts, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「通孔需要可靠落在軌上並維持周圍隔離。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Vias must land reliably on rails while preserving surrounding isolation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「軌接觸落點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for place rail contacts and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 軌接觸落點的原理
knowledge.text: 通孔需要可靠落在軌上並維持周圍隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Vias must land reliably on rails while preserving surrounding isolation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋在前段的金屬會遭遇後續熱處理，選材需同時考慮擴散、應力及介電相容而非只看低電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Metal buried early encounters later heating, so selection needs diffusion, stress and dielectric compatibility beyond low resistance.

selectedSteps.title: 直流壓降
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「直流壓降」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compute dc drop, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「串聯路徑的壓降需依局部電流分段計算。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Series drop should be computed with each segment's local current. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「直流壓降」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compute dc drop and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 直流壓降的原理
knowledge.text: 串聯路徑的壓降需依局部電流分段計算。
knowledge.textEn: Series drop should be computed with each segment's local current.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 壓降減少可能釋出電壓裕度，但電流密度、熱點及電遷移仍需獨立驗證長期穩定性。
