knowledge.textEn: Reduced drop can free voltage margin, but current density, hotspots and electromigration need separate lifetime validation.

selectedSteps.title: 埋軌放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「埋軌放行」的工程驗收單，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release buried-rail integration, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「電性、隔離、熱相容與可佈線性需全部有證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Electrical, isolation, thermal compatibility and routability all need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「埋軌放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release buried-rail integration and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 埋軌放行的原理
knowledge.text: 電性、隔離、熱相容與可佈線性需全部有證據。
knowledge.textEn: Electrical, isolation, thermal compatibility and routability all need evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 壓降減少可能釋出電壓裕度，但電流密度、熱點及電遷移仍需獨立驗證長期穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: Reduced drop can free voltage margin, but current density, hotspots and electromigration need separate lifetime validation.

title: 次二奈米邏輯製程研究

selectedSteps.title: 節點名稱
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「節點名稱」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for interpret node names, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「節點名稱」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret node names and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 節點名稱的原理
knowledge.text: 節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。
knowledge.textEn: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。
knowledge.textEn: Node comparisons require explicit PPA, workload and geometry baselines; commercial names and projections are not performance evidence.

selectedSteps.title: 奈米片選項
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「奈米片選項」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare nanosheet options, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「奈米片選項」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare nanosheet options and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 奈米片選項的原理
knowledge.text: 寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 架構改變會同時影響靜電、電容與加工可達性，單項通道指標的改善不等於整合方案更優。
knowledge.textEn: Architecture changes electrostatics, capacitance and process access; improving one channel metric does not prove a better integrated solution.

selectedSteps.title: 接觸瓶頸
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「接觸瓶頸」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for locate contact bottlenecks, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「通道改善可能被增加的存取電阻抵銷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Channel improvements can be offset by access resistance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「接觸瓶頸」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for locate contact bottlenecks and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 接觸瓶頸的原理
knowledge.text: 通道改善可能被增加的存取電阻抵銷。
knowledge.textEn: Channel improvements can be offset by access resistance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 當接觸與互連占比增加，通道縮放對電路效能的改善可能遞減，需要由元件跨到配線協同設計。
knowledge.textEn: As contacts and interconnects contribute more, channel-scaling gains can diminish, requiring device-routing co-design.

selectedSteps.title: 變異來源
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「變異來源」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for build a variability budget, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「幾何、材料與隨機缺陷需分開估算。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「變異來源」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for build a variability budget and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 變異來源的原理
knowledge.text: 幾何、材料與隨機缺陷需分開估算。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 模擬、測試結構與量產資料的抽樣範圍不同，研究結論應附樣本、偏壓、模型假設及可重現條件。
knowledge.textEn: Simulations, test structures and production data sample different scopes; state samples, bias, model assumptions and reproducibility conditions.

selectedSteps.title: 研究提案交付
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「研究提案交付」的工程驗收單，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for deliver a research proposal, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「提出可量測假說、對照組及失敗判準才可檢驗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A testable proposal needs measurable hypotheses, controls and failure criteria. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「研究提案交付」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for deliver a research proposal and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 研究提案交付的原理
knowledge.text: 提出可量測假說、對照組及失敗判準才可檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: A testable proposal needs measurable hypotheses, controls and failure criteria.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 模擬、測試結構與量產資料的抽樣範圍不同，研究結論應附樣本、偏壓、模型假設及可重現條件。
knowledge.textEn: Simulations, test structures and production data sample different scopes; state samples, bias, model assumptions and reproducibility conditions.

title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作

selectedSteps.title: 內外間隔差別
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「內外間隔差別」的因果圖，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate inner and outer spacers, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 內外間隔差別的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate inner and outer spacers principle
knowledge.text: 內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。
knowledge.textEn: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 內間隔在閘與源汲極間提供電性及化學屏障，其長度與介電常數共同影響寄生電容。
knowledge.textEn: Inner spacers form electrical and chemical barriers between gate and source-drain; length and permittivity jointly affect parasitic capacitance.

selectedSteps.title: 凹蝕選擇比
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「凹蝕選擇比」的因果圖，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define recess selectivity, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「犧牲材料去除量需與通道損失一起量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Measure sacrificial removal together with channel loss. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「凹蝕選擇比」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define recess selectivity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 凹蝕選擇比的原理
knowledge.text: 犧牲材料去除量需與通道損失一起量測。
knowledge.textEn: Measure sacrificial removal together with channel loss.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 各層凹蝕的平均深度及最差偏差都重要，局部過深會改變存取長度，過淺則減少保護裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Mean and worst-layer recess matter: excessive recess alters access length while shallow recess reduces protection margin.

selectedSteps.title: 低介電材料
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「低介電材料」的因果圖，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare low-k materials, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「低介電材料」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare low-k materials and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 低介電材料的原理
knowledge.text: 低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。
knowledge.textEn: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 沉積與回蝕必須形成內部保留、外部清除的幾何選擇性，不能只憑全面膜厚判定成功。
knowledge.textEn: Deposition and etchback must retain recessed material while clearing exposed surfaces; blanket thickness cannot establish success.

selectedSteps.title: 犧牲層釋放
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「犧牲層釋放」的因果圖，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess release survival, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔需承受犧牲層移除的化學環境。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers must survive sacrificial-layer removal. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「犧牲層釋放」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess release survival and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 犧牲層釋放的原理
knowledge.text: 內間隔需承受犧牲層移除的化學環境。
knowledge.textEn: Inner spacers must survive sacrificial-layer removal.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低介電常數材料若在釋放中受損，可能形成源汲極侵蝕路徑，因此電容收益需以化學存活為前提。
knowledge.textEn: A low-k material damaged during release may expose source-drain to attack, so capacitance benefits require chemical survival.

selectedSteps.title: 間隔模組放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「間隔模組放行」的工程驗收單，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the spacer module, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「間隔模組放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the spacer module and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 間隔模組放行的原理
knowledge.text: 尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。
knowledge.textEn: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低介電常數材料若在釋放中受損，可能形成源汲極侵蝕路徑，因此電容收益需以化學存活為前提。
knowledge.textEn: A low-k material damaged during release may expose source-drain to attack, so capacitance benefits require chemical survival.

selectedSteps.title: 電阻與比接觸電阻
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「電阻與比接觸電阻」的因果圖，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate resistance and resistivity, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「電阻與比接觸電阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate resistance and resistivity and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 電阻與比接觸電阻的原理
knowledge.text: 接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。
knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接觸電流可集中在入口附近，傳輸長度將片電阻與界面電阻相連，幾何面積不一定全都有效。
knowledge.textEn: Contact current can crowd near edges; transfer length connects sheet and interface resistance, so not all geometric area is effective.

selectedSteps.title: 表面氧化殘留
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「表面氧化殘留」的因果圖，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess residual oxide, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「薄殘留層也可能顯著增加界面電阻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Even thin residual layers can significantly increase interface resistance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「表面氧化殘留」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess residual oxide and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 表面氧化殘留的原理
knowledge.text: 薄殘留層也可能顯著增加界面電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Even thin residual layers can significantly increase interface resistance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 高活化濃度可縮窄能障，但界面氧化、反應相與粗糙度仍可能主導接觸傳輸。
knowledge.textEn: High active doping can narrow barriers while oxide, reacted phases and roughness can still dominate transport.

selectedSteps.title: TLM 長度陣列
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「TLM 長度陣列」的因果圖，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for lay out a tlm array, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「TLM 長度陣列」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for lay out a tlm array and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: TLM 長度陣列的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Lay out a TLM array principle
knowledge.text: 不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: TLM 的斜率與截距需在適當模型下分離片電阻及接觸貢獻，短接觸與有限幾何會改變抽取。
knowledge.textEn: TLM slope and intercept separate sheet and contact contributions within an appropriate model; finite and short contacts affect extraction.

selectedSteps.title: 溫度依賴
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「溫度依賴」的因果圖，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure temperature dependence, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「溫度趨勢可協助辨識不同傳輸機制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Temperature trends can help distinguish transport mechanisms. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「溫度依賴」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure temperature dependence and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 溫度依賴的原理
knowledge.text: 溫度趨勢可協助辨識不同傳輸機制。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature trends can help distinguish transport mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低阻尾端與高阻尾端對統計的影響不同，報告中位數、分布及失效比例比只展示最低值更能描述批次。
knowledge.textEn: Distribution tails matter differently; median, spread and failure fraction characterize a lot better than its minimum resistance alone.

selectedSteps.title: 接觸改善報告
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「接觸改善報告」的工程驗收單，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for report contact improvement, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「方法、幾何、活化、分布及可靠度都需可追溯。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Method, geometry, activation, distributions and reliability must be traceable. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「接觸改善報告」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for report contact improvement and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 接觸改善報告的原理
knowledge.text: 方法、幾何、活化、分布及可靠度都需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Method, geometry, activation, distributions and reliability must be traceable.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低阻尾端與高阻尾端對統計的影響不同，報告中位數、分布及失效比例比只展示最低值更能描述批次。
knowledge.textEn: Distribution tails matter differently; median, spread and failure fraction characterize a lot better than its minimum resistance alone.

selectedSteps.title: 自對準的含義
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「自對準的含義」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define self-alignment, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「自對準的含義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define self-alignment and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 自對準的含義的原理
knowledge.text: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 自對準保護來自材料選擇性及結構重疊，套刻偏移仍可能縮小落點或增加角落暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.

selectedSteps.title: 離子方向性
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「離子方向性」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess ion directionality, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「方向性有助向下去除但仍可能傷害角落。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Directionality helps downward removal but can still damage corners. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「離子方向性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess ion directionality and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 離子方向性的原理
knowledge.text: 方向性有助向下去除但仍可能傷害角落。
knowledge.textEn: Directionality helps downward removal but can still damage corners.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 方向性蝕刻控制形狀，材料選擇性控制保護層損失，兩種能力需要分開量化。
knowledge.textEn: Directional etching controls shape while selectivity controls protective-layer loss; quantify these capabilities separately.

selectedSteps.title: 蝕刻後殘留
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「蝕刻後殘留」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for classify post-etch residues, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「聚合物與金屬殘留可能需要不同判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Polymer and metal residues need different interpretation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「蝕刻後殘留」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify post-etch residues and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 蝕刻後殘留的原理
knowledge.text: 聚合物與金屬殘留可能需要不同判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Polymer and metal residues need different interpretation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接觸襯層可保護界面卻消耗導體截面，填充完成後仍需檢查空洞與實際連通面積。
knowledge.textEn: Contact liners protect interfaces but consume conductor area; inspect voids and actual connected area after filling.

selectedSteps.title: 開路與高阻
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「開路與高阻」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate opens and high resistance, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「完全開路與部分接觸不良需要不同診斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Complete opens and partial contact failure need different diagnosis. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「開路與高阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate opens and high resistance and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 開路與高阻的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate opens and high resistance principle
knowledge.text: 完全開路與部分接觸不良需要不同診斷。
knowledge.textEn: Complete opens and partial contact failure need different diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 導通、閘隔離及鄰孔隔離是不同電路條件；一種接觸鏈測試不能取代所有漏電與短路檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Continuity, gate isolation and neighbor isolation are different conditions; one chain test cannot replace all leakage and short checks.

selectedSteps.title: SAC 放行
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「SAC 放行」的工程驗收單，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept self-aligned contacts, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「導通、隔離、填充及套刻裕度必須一起驗證。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Continuity, isolation, fill and overlay margin need joint validation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「SAC 放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept self-aligned contacts and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: SAC 放行的原理
knowledge.text: 導通、隔離、填充及套刻裕度必須一起驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Continuity, isolation, fill and overlay margin need joint validation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 導通、閘隔離及鄰孔隔離是不同電路條件；一種接觸鏈測試不能取代所有漏電與短路檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Continuity, gate isolation and neighbor isolation are different conditions; one chain test cannot replace all leakage and short checks.

selectedSteps.title: 曝光波長匹配
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「曝光波長匹配」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for match exposure wavelength, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「曝光波長匹配」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for match exposure wavelength and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 曝光波長匹配的原理
knowledge.text: DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。
knowledge.textEn: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 旋塗的流動受黏度、離心效應與溶劑揮發共同影響，材料換批後應重新確認曲線而非只沿用轉速。
knowledge.textEn: Spin flow depends on viscosity, centrifugal effects and evaporation; a material-lot change requires curve verification beyond reusing speed.

selectedSteps.title: 滴液位置
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「滴液位置」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess dispense position, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「偏心滴液可造成初始覆蓋不均。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Off-center dispensing can cause uneven initial coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：曝光劑量相同就能排除所有尺寸差。 應回到「滴液位置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal dose rules out every dimensional difference. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess dispense position and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 滴液位置的原理
knowledge.text: 偏心滴液可造成初始覆蓋不均。
knowledge.textEn: Off-center dispensing can cause uneven initial coverage.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 液膜在鋪展與乾燥間轉換，前段加速度及排風因此可能改變最終厚度，即使終轉速不變。
knowledge.textEn: The film transitions from spreading to drying, so acceleration and exhaust can alter final thickness even at fixed final speed.

selectedSteps.title: 邊珠去除
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「邊珠去除」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define edge-bead removal evidence, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「邊珠去除」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define edge-bead removal evidence and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 邊珠去除的原理
knowledge.text: 去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。
knowledge.textEn: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 邊珠、背面殘留與氣泡具有不同空間形態，缺陷分類應保留位置而不只計算總數。
knowledge.textEn: Edge beads, backside residues and bubbles have different spatial signatures; retain locations rather than only total defect counts.

selectedSteps.title: 光學常數
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「光學常數」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for check optical constants, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「光學常數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for check optical constants and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 光學常數的原理
knowledge.text: 膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 光阻膜厚與底層反射共同決定內部光場，塗佈端與曝光端需要共用光學堆疊版本。
knowledge.textEn: Resist thickness and underlying reflection determine the internal optical field; coating and exposure should share the stack version.

selectedSteps.title: DUV 塗佈交接
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「DUV 塗佈交接」的工程驗收單，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the duv coating, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚、邊緣、背面及缺陷證據須一起交給曝光端。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「DUV 塗佈交接」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the duv coating and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: DUV 塗佈交接的原理
knowledge.text: 膜厚、邊緣、背面及缺陷證據須一起交給曝光端。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 光阻膜厚與底層反射共同決定內部光場，塗佈端與曝光端需要共用光學堆疊版本。
knowledge.textEn: Resist thickness and underlying reflection determine the internal optical field; coating and exposure should share the stack version.

selectedSteps.title: 軟烤與 PEB
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「軟烤與 PEB」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate softbake and peb, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「軟烤與 PEB」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate softbake and peb and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 軟烤與 PEB的原理
knowledge.text: 除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 軟烤調整溶劑與薄膜狀態，PEB 驅動曝光後反應；兩者的合格結果應以各自的物理目的定義。
knowledge.textEn: Softbake adjusts solvent and film state while PEB drives post-exposure reaction; accept each against its own physical purpose.

selectedSteps.title: 曝光後等待
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「曝光後等待」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for track post-exposure delay, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「等待時間會改變酸遷移及污染中和機會。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Delay changes acid transport and opportunities for contaminant neutralization. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：曝光劑量相同就能排除所有尺寸差。 應回到「曝光後等待」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal dose rules out every dimensional difference. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track post-exposure delay and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 曝光後等待的原理
knowledge.text: 等待時間會改變酸遷移及污染中和機會。
knowledge.textEn: Delay changes acid transport and opportunities for contaminant neutralization.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 酸催化與酸擴散同時發生，較完全的去保護可能伴隨較大的影像模糊，需要聯合量測。
knowledge.textEn: Acid catalysis and diffusion occur together; more complete deprotection can accompany more blur, requiring joint measurements.

selectedSteps.title: 正負型溶解
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「正負型溶解」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate positive and negative tone, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「顯影保留區由材料反應與顯影化學共同決定。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Remaining regions depend on both resist chemistry and developer. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「正負型溶解」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate positive and negative tone and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 正負型溶解的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate positive and negative tone principle
knowledge.text: 顯影保留區由材料反應與顯影化學共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Remaining regions depend on both resist chemistry and developer.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 顯影產物移除受局部傳質限制，厚膜或細孔的清除不能由平面大開口結果直接預測。
knowledge.textEn: Product removal depends on local transport, so thick-film or small-hole clearance cannot follow directly from large planar openings.

selectedSteps.title: 底部殘膠
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「底部殘膠」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify scum, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「底部殘膠」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify scum and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 底部殘膠的原理
knowledge.text: 上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。
knowledge.textEn: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 尺寸、底部殘膠與側壁角是互補圖案指標；頂視 CD 合格仍可能無法完成後續蝕刻轉移。
knowledge.textEn: CD, bottom scum and sidewall angle are complementary; acceptable top-view CD can still fail later etch transfer.

selectedSteps.title: 光阻圖案交接
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「光阻圖案交接」的工程驗收單，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the resist pattern, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「線寬、輪廓、殘膠及薄膜損失需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Width, profile, scum and retained-film loss must jointly meet requirements. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「光阻圖案交接」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the resist pattern and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 光阻圖案交接的原理
knowledge.text: 線寬、輪廓、殘膠及薄膜損失需共同符合要求。
knowledge.textEn: Width, profile, scum and retained-film loss must jointly meet requirements.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 尺寸、底部殘膠與側壁角是互補圖案指標；頂視 CD 合格仍可能無法完成後續蝕刻轉移。
knowledge.textEn: CD, bottom scum and sidewall angle are complementary; acceptable top-view CD can still fail later etch transfer.

selectedSteps.title: 放大機制定義
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「放大機制定義」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define amplification, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「放大機制定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define amplification and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 放大機制定義的原理
knowledge.text: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。
knowledge.textEn: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。
knowledge.textEn: Chemical amplification links absorption to multiple catalytic conversions, while acid yield, quenching and dissolution set effective gain.

selectedSteps.title: 吸收深度
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「吸收深度」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for estimate absorption depth, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「過強吸收可能造成上下層反應不均。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Excessive absorption can produce through-film reaction gradients. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：曝光劑量相同就能排除所有尺寸差。 應回到「吸收深度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal dose rules out every dimensional difference. Revisit assumptions and sampling for estimate absorption depth and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 吸收深度的原理
knowledge.text: 過強吸收可能造成上下層反應不均。
knowledge.textEn: Excessive absorption can produce through-film reaction gradients.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 擴散長度與反應速率是不同參數，藉獨立圖案或時間實驗才能避免把反應加快誤判為酸移動更遠。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion length and reaction rate are different parameters; independent spatial or time experiments avoid confusing faster reaction with farther transport.

selectedSteps.title: 感度解析度粗糙度
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「感度解析度粗糙度」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「降低曝光劑量不保證同時提升解析度與粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Lower dose does not guarantee better resolution and roughness together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「感度解析度粗糙度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 感度解析度粗糙度的原理
knowledge.text: 降低曝光劑量不保證同時提升解析度與粗糙度。
knowledge.textEn: Lower dose does not guarantee better resolution and roughness together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 平均化學反應與少量事件的隨機分布需分開看，低曝光劑量可能增加局部缺陷的不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Separate average chemistry from sparse-event statistics; low dose can increase uncertainty in local defect formation.

selectedSteps.title: 蝕刻耐受
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「蝕刻耐受」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess etch resistance, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高感度材料仍需要足夠圖案轉移耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sensitive materials still need sufficient pattern-transfer durability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「蝕刻耐受」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess etch resistance and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 蝕刻耐受的原理
knowledge.text: 高感度材料仍需要足夠圖案轉移耐受。
knowledge.textEn: Sensitive materials still need sufficient pattern-transfer durability.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 候選配方的解析度、粗糙度、感度及蝕刻耐受需在同一基準下比較，不能混用不同最佳條件宣稱全面勝出。
knowledge.textEn: Compare resolution, roughness, sensitivity and etch resistance on the same baseline rather than mixing best conditions to claim universal superiority.

selectedSteps.title: 光阻材料評估
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「光阻材料評估」的工程驗收單，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for deliver a resist assessment, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需用相同曝光、顯影及蝕刻基準比較候選材料。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Compare candidate materials with matched exposure, development and etch baselines. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「光阻材料評估」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for deliver a resist assessment and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 光阻材料評估的原理
knowledge.text: 需用相同曝光、顯影及蝕刻基準比較候選材料。
knowledge.textEn: Compare candidate materials with matched exposure, development and etch baselines.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 候選配方的解析度、粗糙度、感度及蝕刻耐受需在同一基準下比較，不能混用不同最佳條件宣稱全面勝出。
knowledge.textEn: Compare resolution, roughness, sensitivity and etch resistance on the same baseline rather than mixing best conditions to claim universal superiority.

title: 極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究

selectedSteps.title: 畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈
selectedSteps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
selectedSteps.observation: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
selectedSteps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

knowledge.title: 本步技術判讀
knowledge.text: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
knowledge.textEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.

knowledge.title: 吸收與反應路徑的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and reaction: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

selectedSteps.title: 繪製中心到邊緣的膜厚取樣網格
selectedSteps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：單點膜厚無法證明晶圓均勻性。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: One thickness point cannot establish wafer uniformity.
selectedSteps.observation: 單點膜厚無法證明晶圓均勻性。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
selectedSteps.observationEn: One thickness point cannot establish wafer uniformity. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
selectedSteps.failure: 若報告假設「相同厚度就表示化學組成相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Equal thickness proves equal chemical composition.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

knowledge.title: 本步技術判讀
knowledge.text: 單點膜厚無法證明晶圓均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: One thickness point cannot establish wafer uniformity.

knowledge.title: 塗膜與表面的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Coating and surfaces: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 薄膜厚度與組成會同時影響吸收、顆粒及顯影結果。

selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.
selectedSteps.observation:
劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
確認面積換算、200 μC/cm² 與 0.30 s，分開曝光和開銷。
selectedSteps.observationEn:
Dose is charge divided by exposed area. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Check the area conversion, 200 μC/cm² and 0.30 s, separating exposure and overhead.

knowledge.text: 劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。
knowledge.textEn: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設某圖元曝光面積為 100 μm²、所需總電荷為 0.20 nC、束流為 1.0 nA。先換算 100 μm²=10⁻⁶ cm²，再得面劑量 200 μC/cm²，理想駐留總時間 Q/I=0.20 s。另有 0.10 s 載台與資料開銷時，總時間是 0.30 s；不可把理想束流時間當作整體吞吐量。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 100 μm² exposed area, total charge 0.20 nC and beam current 1.0 nA. Convert the area to 10⁻⁶ cm²: dose is 200 μC/cm² and ideal beam time Q/I is 0.20 s. With 0.10 s of stage and data overhead, total time is 0.30 s; beam time alone is not throughput.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 在假設的四面反射鏡教學光路中，每面能量反射率皆為 0.70，且忽略其他損失。總傳輸比例為 0.70⁴=0.2401；100 單位入射能量只剩 24.01 單位。若其中一面因污染變成 0.60，剩餘為 0.70³×0.60=20.58，較原來降低 14.3%。本例鏡數與反射率不是任何 EUV 機台規格。
knowledge.textEn: In a hypothetical four-mirror path, each mirror has energy reflectivity 0.70 and other losses are ignored. Total transmission is 0.70⁴=0.2401, leaving 24.01 of 100 incident energy units. If one mirror falls to 0.60, the result is 0.70³×0.60=20.58, a 14.3% relative decrease. Mirror count and reflectivities are not specifications of any EUV scanner.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 設兩組交錯線條在完美對位時的左右間隙皆為 40 nm。第二組向右偏移 5 nm，而線寬不變，則左右間隙變成 45 nm 與 35 nm，平均仍為 40 nm。若最小間隙要求為 36 nm，這組圖形不合格，即使平均間隙完全正確。畫出帶方向的套刻向量與兩個間隙。
knowledge.textEn: Two interleaved line sets have 40 nm gaps on both sides at ideal alignment. Shift the second set 5 nm right without changing widths: gaps become 45 and 35 nm while their mean remains 40 nm. A 36 nm minimum-gap requirement is violated despite the correct mean. Draw the signed overlay vector and both gaps.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 設理想骨架節距為 160 nm；每輪側壁倍增恰好使規則線群節距減半。第一輪為 80 nm，第二輪為 40 nm。這並不表示最終線寬是 40 nm：若目標線寬為 15 nm，名目間隙應為 25 nm。另標記切割光罩的位置需求，避免把四倍線密度誤解為完整電路已完成。
knowledge.textEn: Assume an ideal 160 nm mandrel pitch and each spacer multiplication exactly halves regular-line pitch. The first cycle gives 80 nm and the second 40 nm. Final linewidth is not therefore 40 nm: a 15 nm line leaves a nominal 25 nm gap. Also mark cut-mask placement requirements so fourfold line density is not mistaken for a completed circuit.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設模板凹槽總體積 100 μm³，壓印區面積 1000 μm²，目標殘留層厚度 0.020 μm。理想所需樹脂體積為 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³。若滴入 140 μm³且完全填充、沒有流出或收縮，殘留層為 (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm，即 40 nm。實際還需評估氣泡、收縮與局部密度，不能只用總體積保證均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 μm³ of template-cavity volume, 1000 μm² imprint area and a target 0.020 μm residual layer. Ideal resin volume is 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³. Dispensing 140 μm³ with complete filling and no outflow or shrinkage yields (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm, or 40 nm, residual thickness. Bubbles, shrinkage and local density still matter; total volume does not guarantee uniformity.

knowledge.textEn: For independent opportunities, the approximate 95% upper bound is 3 divided by sample count.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設 N=100000 個獨立、同分布機會皆無缺陷。精確單側 95% 二項上限為 p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵，近似 3/N=3.0×10⁻⁵。若報告 p=0，便超出資料支持範圍。另說明漏檢與空間相關會破壞此計算的假設；此範例沒有實際晶圓良率數據。
knowledge.textEn: For N=100000 independent identically distributed opportunities with zero defects, the exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound is p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵; 3/N approximates it as 3.0×10⁻⁵. Reporting p=0 exceeds the evidence. Missed detections and spatial correlation violate assumptions; the example contains no measured wafer-yield data.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設介電孔深 1000 nm，孔口 100 nm，中段最大孔徑 120 nm，孔底最小孔徑 60 nm。以孔口計 AR=10，但以最小孔徑計有效幾何比為 16.7；中段相對孔口膨脹 20%。在同一截面標出三個量測位置，不能只用孔口照片宣告全孔垂直與等寬。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 1000 nm deep dielectric hole with 100 nm opening, 120 nm maximum mid-depth diameter and 60 nm minimum bottom diameter. Opening-based AR is 10, while the minimum-diameter ratio is 16.7; mid-depth bow is 20% relative to the opening. Mark all three sites in one section rather than declaring a straight, uniform hole from an opening image.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 使用假想平行板電容 A=1.00 mm²、膜厚 t=1.00 μm、C=35.416 pF，忽略邊緣與寄生電容。由 εr=Ct/(ε0A)，ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，得到 εr=4.00。若未扣除 5 pF 寄生，表觀值約 4.565；這說明量測寄生不能直接歸因於膜成分。
knowledge.textEn: Use a hypothetical parallel-plate capacitor with A=1.00 mm², t=1.00 μm and C=35.416 pF, initially neglecting fringing and parasitics. εr=Ct/(ε0A), with ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m, gives 4.00. An unremoved 5 pF parasitic gives an apparent 4.565, showing why parasitics cannot be attributed directly to film composition.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設三個爐管位置的見證片膜厚為 50、55、60 nm。平均值為 55 nm；本例定義半範圍不均勻度 U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%。若另一批三片皆 55 nm，平均仍相同但 U=0。只用批次平均無法判斷軸向均勻性；三片也不足以證明所有晶圓位置。
knowledge.textEn: Three hypothetical furnace witness wafers measure 50, 55 and 60 nm. Mean is 55 nm; define half-range nonuniformity U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%. Another batch with three 55 nm values has the same mean but U=0. Batch means cannot establish axial uniformity, and three wafers cannot establish every position.

knowledge.textEn: Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設線槽寬 40 nm、高 60 nm，兩側與底部各由 3 nm 非銅襯層占用，不計頂部帽層。銅截面為 (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm²，而外部截面為 2400 nm²。若銅電阻率與長度固定，襯層占用使電阻相對理想全銅增加 2400/1938-1≈23.8%。這尚未計入尺寸散射與接觸電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 40 nm wide, 60 nm tall trench with 3 nm non-copper liners on both sides and bottom, excluding a top cap. Copper area is (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm² versus 2400 nm² external area. With fixed copper resistivity and length, liner occupancy raises resistance by 2400/1938-1≈23.8% over ideal all-copper. Size scattering and contact resistance are excluded.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」。
假設數值與推算：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.

knowledge.title: 磨粒族群／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」。
假設數值與推算：假設漿料 A 的離散計數為 9,999 顆直徑 100 nm 加 1 顆 1,000 nm，B 為 10,000 顆直徑 100.09 nm。兩者數目加權平均均為 100.09 nm；大於 500 nm 的顆數卻為 A=1、B=0。畫出尾端計數，說明平均值相同仍可能有不同大粒子風險；這不是實際漿料規格，亦不能單由粒徑斷定刮傷。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume slurry A contains 9,999 particles of diameter 100 nm and one of 1,000 nm; B contains 10,000 particles of 100.09 nm. Both number-weighted means are 100.09 nm, but counts above 500 nm are A=1 and B=0. Plot tail counts and explain how equal means conceal large-particle differences. These are not slurry specifications, and diameter alone does not establish scratching.

knowledge.title: 電場與厚度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Field and thickness / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」。
假設數值與推算：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.

knowledge.title: 垂直字串／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」。
假設數值與推算：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating stack layers with bits per cell.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.

knowledge.titleEn: Thickness and field / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「用電壓相同就宣稱不同厚度測試公平」。
假設數值與推算：假設均勻 HZO 薄膜厚 10 nm，真正跨薄膜電壓為 1 V，平均場 E=1 MV/cm；改為 20 nm 則為 0.5 MV/cm。這個換算不能證明鐵電性或矯頑場；介面層分壓、漏電和量測波形需另外檢查。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Claiming fair thickness comparison from equal voltage.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a uniform 10 nm HZO film with an actual 1 V drop: average E=1 MV/cm; at 20 nm it is 0.5 MV/cm. This conversion does not demonstrate ferroelectricity or a coercive field; interface voltage division, leakage and the measurement waveform require separate checks.

knowledge.title: 直接飛行時間／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Direct time of flight / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「直接用 cΔt 作為單程距離」。
假設數值與推算：假設直接 ToF 系統已扣除電子延遲，測得往返時間 10 ns，取 c=3×10⁸ m/s，距離 d=ct/2=1.5 m。若時間誤差為 1 ns，對應距離誤差幅度 0.15 m。未處理多重路徑、光子統計及介質折射率；不可省略往返的二分之一。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Using cΔt as one-way distance.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a direct-ToF system has removed electronic delay and measures a 10 ns round trip. With c=3×10⁸ m/s, d=ct/2=1.5 m. A 1 ns timing-error magnitude corresponds to 0.15 m. Multipath, photon statistics and medium refractive index are excluded; the round-trip factor of one-half is essential.

knowledge.title: 厚度均勻度／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「中心厚度合格就代表全片耐壓一致」。
假設數值與推算：假設三個外延厚度測點為 99、100、101 µm，平均 100 µm、極差 2 µm。若僅描述這三點、使用母體定義，標準差 sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm，變異係數 0.8165%；若作樣本估計則標準差為 1 µm。必須寫明分母，且三點不能推論整片缺陷密度。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Inferring uniform blocking capability from center thickness.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume three epitaxial thickness readings of 99, 100 and 101 µm. Mean is 100 µm and range 2 µm. Describing just these points with the population definition gives standard deviation sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm and CV=0.8165%; the sample estimate instead gives 1 µm. State the denominator; three sites cannot establish wafer-wide defect density.

knowledge.title: 接觸抽取／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」。
假設數值與推算：假設二維材料元件的 TLM 資料符合線性 Rtotal(L)，截距 2 kΩ，且兩接觸相同，則每個接觸為 1 kΩ。若某長度的量測總阻為 5 kΩ，模型歸於通道的部分為 3 kΩ。此分解依賴接觸與通道一致性，不適用於任意非線性注入曲線。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a 2D-device TLM dataset follows linear Rtotal(L) with intercept 2 kΩ and identical contacts: each contact is 1 kΩ. If total resistance at one spacing is 5 kΩ, the model assigns 3 kΩ to the channel. This decomposition assumes contact/channel consistency and does not apply to arbitrary nonlinear injection curves.

knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「用形貌成功百分比代表全部電路良率」與「高覆蓋率不等於高功能良率」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

knowledge.titleEn: Mass and spring / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」。
假設數值與推算：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Applying static displacement at every frequency.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.

knowledge.title: 週期標靶／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「不定義形狀便宣稱光譜能直接讀出線寬」。
假設數值與推算：假設對稱梯形線條高 100 nm、頂寬 40 nm、底寬 60 nm，每側水平差為 (60−40)/2=10 nm。相對水平面的側壁角 atan(100/10)≈84.29°；相對垂直面的傾斜約 5.71°。這是已知幾何的計算，不能證明光學反演已唯一決定此形貌。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Reading CD directly from spectra without geometry assumptions.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a symmetric trapezoidal line 100 nm high, 40 nm wide at top and 60 nm at bottom. Each side shifts horizontally by 10 nm. Sidewall angle from horizontal is atan(100/10)≈84.29°, or 5.71° from vertical. This computes known geometry; it does not prove a unique optical inverse solution.

knowledge.title: 良率模型／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「任意聚集分布都用同一密度精確預測」。
假設數值與推算：假設致命缺陷為空間獨立均勻 Poisson 過程，晶粒面積 A=1 cm²、缺陷密度 D0=0.1 cm⁻²，零缺陷良率 Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%。面積加倍時 Y≈81.87%。聚集缺陷、冗餘修復與參數失效不在模型內，不能當實廠良率預測。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Predicting arbitrary clustering from mean density alone.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume spatially independent uniform Poisson killer defects with die area A=1 cm² and density D0=0.1 cm⁻². Zero-defect yield Y=exp(−AD0)=exp(−0.1)≈90.48%; doubling area gives 81.87%. Clustering, repair redundancy and parametric failures are excluded; this is not a fab-yield prediction.

knowledge.title: 能力指標／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「任意失控序列也可直接宣稱 Cpk 保證」。
假設數值與推算：假設穩定且近似常態的製程，規格 LSL=95、USL=105，平均 μ=101、組內標準差 σ=1（使用同一單位）。Cp=(105−95)/(6σ)=1.667；Cpk=min((105−101)/(3σ),(101−95)/(3σ))=1.333。此組假設尚未由資料驗證，控制界限也不等於 95/105 規格界限。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Claiming capability guarantees for an unstable sequence.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume a stable approximately normal process with LSL=95, USL=105, mean μ=101 and within-process σ=1 in common units. Cp=10/(6σ)=1.667; Cpk=min(4/(3σ),6/(3σ))=1.333. These assumptions still need data support; control limits are not the 95/105 specification limits.

knowledge.titleEn: Equipment energy saving / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「關機時間越長就一定總成本最低」。
假設數值與推算：假設同一設備在 8 小時比較窗口中，維持工作狀態為 10 kW、可用待機狀態為 2 kW。能耗分別 80 與 16 kWh，差 64 kWh；若喚醒與重新穩定另耗 10 kWh，淨差才是 54 kWh。這是自訂能源帳，不是台積電實測資料，也未計產能與良率代價。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming longer shutdown always minimizes total cost.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume an 8-hour comparison for one tool: active power 10 kW versus an available standby state at 2 kW. Energy is 80 versus 16 kWh, a 64 kWh difference; if wakeup and restabilization add 10 kWh, net savings are 54 kWh. These invented teaching inputs are not TSMC measurements and exclude throughput and yield costs.

selectedSteps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming a pathfinding pass guarantees immediate volume fabrication", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

selectedSteps.title: 里程碑核對：故障判讀與驗證

selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating a schedule as completed measurement evidence.
selectedSteps.observation: 各里程碑代表不同完成程度；設備校正和產品資格是不同驗收。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Milestones represent different completion states; Tool qualification and product qualification differ.
selectedSteps.failure: 若採用「把預定時程當成已完成量測結果」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating a schedule as completed measurement evidence", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

knowledge.title: 里程碑核對／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：設備校正和產品資格是不同驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Tool qualification and product qualification differ.

knowledge.title: 里程碑核對／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把預定時程當成已完成量測結果」與「各里程碑代表不同完成程度」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating a schedule as completed measurement evidence" is not equivalent to "Milestones represent different completion states"; the control must expose their difference.

selectedSteps.title: 辨識封裝功能邊界
selectedSteps.objective: 把晶粒、封裝及電路板畫成三個介面區，並能說明「封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護」。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Draw die, package and PCB as separate interfaces and explain: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection.
selectedSteps.observation: 每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
selectedSteps.failure: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.

knowledge.title: 本工序機制
knowledge.text: 封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護。
knowledge.textEn: Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection.

knowledge.title: 異常診斷與判讀邊界
knowledge.text: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面；應回查本步輸入證據，不能以猜測取代判定。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces. Recheck this operation's input evidence instead of substituting a guess.

selectedSteps.title: 確認打線專屬路線
selectedSteps.objective: 將周邊焊墊連到導線架或基板，並能說明「打線不是覆晶凸塊後的必經站」。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Connect peripheral pads to leadframe or substrate and explain: Wirebonding is not mandatory after flipchip bumping.
selectedSteps.observation: 流程圖未把兩分支強制串接；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
selectedSteps.observationEn: The map does not force both branches in series; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
selectedSteps.failure: 混接分支會增加不存在的接點。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Mixed branches introduce nonexistent interconnects.

knowledge.title: 本工序機制
knowledge.text: 打線不是覆晶凸塊後的必經站。
knowledge.textEn: Wirebonding is not mandatory after flipchip bumping.

knowledge.title: 異常診斷與判讀邊界
knowledge.text: 混接分支會增加不存在的接點；應回查本步輸入證據，不能以猜測取代判定。
knowledge.textEn: Mixed branches introduce nonexistent interconnects. Recheck this operation's input evidence instead of substituting a guess.

selectedSteps.title: TSV 深寬比核對
selectedSteps.objective: 判斷「TSV 深寬比核對」是否滿足此具體條件：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Check TSV aspect ratio meets this specific condition: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察重點：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
selectedSteps.failure: 入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.

knowledge.title: TSV 深寬比核對的驗證依據
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence for Check TSV aspect ratio
knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍」。可藉由「由剖面資料計算孔深與最小孔寬比」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Evidence can be developed through this action: Calculate depth divided by minimum width from cross sections. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: TSV 深寬比核對的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Check TSV aspect ratio
knowledge.text: 入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 工程算例與模型邊界
knowledge.text: 深寬比以指定寬度定義；假設孔深 50 µm、入口直徑 5 µm，AR=10。若底部縮成 3 µm，入口 AR 不能描述孔底覆蓋難度。
knowledge.textEn: Define aspect ratio using a stated width; hypothetical depth 50 µm and entrance diameter 5 µm give AR=10. A 3 µm bottom means entrance AR misses bottom coverage difficulty.

knowledge.title: 進階判據與診斷策略
knowledge.text: 保留孔深、口徑、底徑、側壁角及扇貝紋。高 AR 所需襯層與種子覆蓋不能由平面膜厚直接推定。
knowledge.textEn: Retain depth, entrance and bottom diameters, sidewall angle and scallops. Planar film thickness does not establish high-AR liner or seed coverage.

selectedSteps.title: HBM 基底晶粒驗證
selectedSteps.objective: 判斷「HBM 基底晶粒驗證」是否滿足此具體條件：基底狀態及介面版本皆有效。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Verify an HBM base die meets this specific condition: Base status and interface revision are valid.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察重點：基底狀態及介面版本皆有效；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Base status and interface revision are valid. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
selectedSteps.failure: 基底失效會使上層良品晶粒一同損失。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: A failing base wastes otherwise good upper dies. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.

knowledge.title: HBM 基底晶粒驗證的驗證依據
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence for Verify an HBM base die
knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「基底狀態及介面版本皆有效」。可藉由「核對基底晶粒測試記錄與堆疊版本」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Base status and interface revision are valid. Evidence can be developed through this action: Match base-die test records and stack revisions. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: HBM 基底晶粒驗證的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Verify an HBM base die
knowledge.text: 基底失效會使上層良品晶粒一同損失。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: A failing base wastes otherwise good upper dies. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

selectedSteps.title: 產品測試與譜系移交
selectedSteps.objective: 判斷「產品測試與譜系移交」是否滿足此具體條件：交付狀態與所有識別資料一致。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Determine whether Handoff product test and genealogy meets this specific condition: Delivery status agrees with all identifiers.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察重點：交付狀態與所有識別資料一致；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observable evidence: Delivery status agrees with all identifiers. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
selectedSteps.failure: 測試通過不能替代缺失的可靠度資格。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Test passing cannot replace missing reliability qualification. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.

knowledge.title: 產品測試與譜系移交的驗證依據
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence for Handoff product test and genealogy
knowledge.text: 可檢驗條件為「交付狀態與所有識別資料一致」。可藉由「封存材料版本晶粒來源測試與修復對映」建立證據；資料須自行提供或查證取得，完成動作與結果合格是兩個不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: The testable condition is: Delivery status agrees with all identifiers. Evidence can be developed through this action: Archive material revisions, die origins, tests, and repair maps. Supply or verify the data; performing an action and obtaining an acceptable result are separate questions.

knowledge.title: 產品測試與譜系移交的失效線索
knowledge.titleEn: Failure clues for Handoff product test and genealogy
knowledge.text: 測試通過不能替代缺失的可靠度資格。將此線索與本步量測位置、材料狀態及前後差異交叉比對，保留其他合理原因直到證據足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Test passing cannot replace missing reliability qualification. Cross-check this clue against measurement location, material state, and before-and-after differences; retain alternative explanations until the evidence distinguishes them.

title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎
