selectedSteps.title: 分辨光與電介面
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「分辨光與電介面」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for distinguish optical and electrical interfaces.
selectedSteps.observation: 光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 在系統圖區分光路、電路與控制路徑。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Separate optical, electrical and control paths in the system diagram.
selectedSteps.failure: 把熱調諧控制線當成高速資料線，會混淆頻寬需求。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Treating a thermal-control line as the high-speed data path confuses bandwidth requirements.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。
knowledge.textEn: Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 在系統圖區分光路、電路與控制路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Separate optical, electrical and control paths in the system diagram.

selectedSteps.title: 建立光子製程模組
selectedSteps.objective: 完成「建立光子製程模組」的概念模型與工程檢核。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for map photonic process modules.
selectedSteps.observation: 波導、摻雜區、金屬及光學材料需以相容流程整合。 建立模組相依圖並標出熱預算衝突。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Waveguides, doped regions, metals and optical materials need compatible integration. Build dependencies and mark thermal-budget conflicts.
selectedSteps.failure: 把不同代工平台的單項最佳數字合併會產生不存在的流程。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Combining best numbers from different foundries creates a nonexistent flow.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 波導、摻雜區、金屬及光學材料需以相容流程整合。
knowledge.textEn: Waveguides, doped regions, metals and optical materials need compatible integration.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 建立模組相依圖並標出熱預算衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Build dependencies and mark thermal-budget conflicts.

selectedSteps.title: 分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate reference planes and insertion loss
selectedSteps.objective: 報告 6.02 dB 並保留參考面、波長和偏振。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Report 6.02 dB with reference planes, wavelength and polarization.
selectedSteps.observation: 假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。
selectedSteps.observationEn: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included.
selectedSteps.failure: 重新插拔參考線後未重校正，會把治具漂移當元件變化。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Reconnecting without rereferencing makes fixture drift appear to be device change.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 損耗附波長、偏振與參考面；端到端數字不能冒充波導本身損耗。
knowledge.textEn: Loss requires wavelength, polarization and reference planes; end-to-end loss is not waveguide loss alone.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。 驗收：報告 6.02 dB 並保留參考面、波長和偏振。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included. Acceptance: Report 6.02 dB with reference planes, wavelength and polarization.

selectedSteps.title: 建立固化位移預算
selectedSteps.objective: 分列偏置和隨機項，對照對位容差。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Separate bias and random terms and compare with alignment tolerance.
selectedSteps.observation: 假設三個同向位移 0.2、0.3、0.4 µm，最壞和 0.9 µm；只有獨立零均值隨機項可用 RSS=0.539 µm 作標準差估計。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Three hypothetical same-direction shifts 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4 µm sum to 0.9 µm worst case; RSS=0.539 µm is a standard-deviation estimate only for independent zero-mean random terms.
selectedSteps.failure: 將確定性收縮也 RSS 會低估系統偏差。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Applying RSS to deterministic shrinkage underestimates systematic bias.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 光纖受固化收縮、解夾和冷卻共同影響；自由收縮率不直接等於端點位移。
knowledge.textEn: Fiber position depends on cure shrinkage, clamp release and cooling; free shrinkage is not endpoint displacement.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設三個同向位移 0.2、0.3、0.4 µm，最壞和 0.9 µm；只有獨立零均值隨機項可用 RSS=0.539 µm 作標準差估計。 驗收：分列偏置和隨機項，對照對位容差。
knowledge.textEn: Three hypothetical same-direction shifts 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4 µm sum to 0.9 µm worst case; RSS=0.539 µm is a standard-deviation estimate only for independent zero-mean random terms. Acceptance: Separate bias and random terms and compare with alignment tolerance.

selectedSteps.title: 交付可重現 CPO 設計審查
selectedSteps.objective: 另一人能重算損耗及相位並指出適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: A peer can reproduce loss and phase and identify validity limits.
selectedSteps.observation: 最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。
selectedSteps.observationEn: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement.
selectedSteps.failure: 只有示意圖而缺單位和參考面，無法稽核。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Schematics without units or reference planes are unauditable.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 交付應讓他人以相同輸入重算，並區分預測、教學算例和實測。
knowledge.textEn: Handoff should enable recomputation from identical inputs and distinguish predictions, examples and measurements.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。 驗收：另一人能重算損耗及相位並指出適用邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement. Acceptance: A peer can reproduce loss and phase and identify validity limits.

stages.title: 表面形貌、污染與接合波
統計、根因與資格交付
stages.titleEn: Statistics, root cause and qualification handoff

selectedSteps.title: 界定混合接合的兩種功能
selectedSteps.titleEn: Define the two functions of hybrid bonding
selectedSteps.objective: 區別介電層支撐與金屬導通。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Distinguish dielectric attachment from metal conduction.
selectedSteps.observation: 整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.
selectedSteps.failure: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
selectedSteps.failureEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.

knowledge.title: 雙重界面
knowledge.text: 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

knowledge.title: 功能分驗
knowledge.text: 機械完整與電性導通互相關聯，但不能互相替代驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical integrity and electrical continuity are related but need separate evidence.

selectedSteps.title: 判讀退火對介電層與銅連接的作用
selectedSteps.titleEn: Interpret annealing of dielectric and copper bonds
selectedSteps.objective: 區分初始貼合與後續接合強化。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Distinguish initial attachment from subsequent bond strengthening.
selectedSteps.observation: 某條研究路線的可用條件不代表所有介電材料與金屬堆疊皆適用。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Conditions demonstrated for one research route do not apply automatically to every dielectric and metal stack.
selectedSteps.failure: 用提高溫度補償未知污染，可能增加其他損害而未處理根因。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Raising temperature to compensate for unknown contamination may add damage without addressing the cause.

knowledge.title: 接合演變
knowledge.text: 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
knowledge.textEn: Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

knowledge.title: 熱預算相容性
knowledge.text: 接合條件須與先前完成的元件和互連相容。
knowledge.textEn: Bonding conditions must remain compatible with existing devices and interconnects.

selectedSteps.title: 區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲
selectedSteps.titleEn: Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow
selectedSteps.objective: 為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.
selectedSteps.observation: 教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other.
selectedSteps.failure: 小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
selectedSteps.failureEn: A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 奈米級表面粗糙、局部 Cu 凹陷與全片翹曲分属不同空間尺度，單一 RMS 不能同時描述。
knowledge.textEn: Nanoscale roughness, local Cu recess and wafer bow occur at different spatial scales; one RMS cannot describe them all.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。 驗收：為三種尺度各指定獨立指標與量測方法。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other. Acceptance: Assign independent metrics and methods to all three scales.

selectedSteps.title: 以四端結構分離接點電阻
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate contact resistance with four terminals
selectedSteps.objective: 列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: List units, terminals, current-reversal check and uncertainty.
selectedSteps.observation: 假設 I=10 mA、ΔV=50 µV，R=5 mΩ；若量測偏置 10 µV 未扣除，誤差相當於 1 mΩ。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Hypothetical I=10 mA and ΔV=50 µV give R=5 mΩ; an unremoved 10 µV offset corresponds to 1 mΩ error.
selectedSteps.failure: 毫伏與微伏混用會造成千倍錯誤。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Confusing millivolts and microvolts creates a thousandfold error.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 四端量測將施加電流與感測電壓分開以降低導線電阻影響，但仍需正確結構和寄生修正。
knowledge.textEn: Four-terminal measurement separates current and voltage paths to reduce lead resistance, but still requires valid structures and parasitic correction.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 假設 I=10 mA、ΔV=50 µV，R=5 mΩ；若量測偏置 10 µV 未扣除，誤差相當於 1 mΩ。 驗收：列單位、端點、反向電流檢查及不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Hypothetical I=10 mA and ΔV=50 µV give R=5 mΩ; an unremoved 10 µV offset corresponds to 1 mΩ error. Acceptance: List units, terminals, current-reversal check and uncertainty.

selectedSteps.title: 交付 W2W 資格證據封包
selectedSteps.objective: 另一人可重算例題並區分研究事實與未驗需求。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: A peer can recompute examples and distinguish research facts from unverified requirements.
selectedSteps.observation: 官方 2026 年 200 nm W2W 研究展示是有日期和試片範圍的里程碑；本課 1 µm 方墊算例不能被標為該流程複製。
selectedSteps.observationEn: The official 2026 200 nm W2W study is a dated test-vehicle milestone; this course's 1 µm square-pad examples are not reproductions of that flow.
selectedSteps.failure: 把不同世代研究數字混成一份虛構量產配方會失去來源可追溯性。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Combining different research generations into a fictional production recipe destroys traceability.

knowledge.title: 機制、公式與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 研究節距紀錄、教學模擬與供應商資格需分開標示；交付應可追溯至晶圓、版圖與量測版本。
knowledge.textEn: Research pitch records, teaching simulations and supplier qualification must be separately labeled and traceable to wafers, layouts and measurement versions.

knowledge.title: 原創算例與判讀
knowledge.text: 官方 2026 年 200 nm W2W 研究展示是有日期和試片範圍的里程碑；本課 1 µm 方墊算例不能被標為該流程複製。 驗收：另一人可重算例題並區分研究事實與未驗需求。
knowledge.textEn: The official 2026 200 nm W2W study is a dated test-vehicle milestone; this course's 1 µm square-pad examples are not reproductions of that flow. Acceptance: A peer can recompute examples and distinguish research facts from unverified requirements.

selectedSteps.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Pad and bump coordinates | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對焊墊與凸塊座標，把「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For pad and bump coordinates, turn "Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 焊墊與凸塊座標：機制
knowledge.text: 焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。
knowledge.textEn: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 必須排除的錯判：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Misinterpretation to reject: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 電荷與高度預算｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Charge and height budget | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對電荷與高度預算，把「法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For charge and height budget, turn "Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：總電荷相同必有相同每顆柱高。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal total charge gives equal height at every pillar. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 電荷與高度預算：機制
knowledge.text: 法拉第關係把總電荷連到理想沉積質量，實際高度還受電流效率、有效面積及邊緣電流影響。
knowledge.textEn: Faraday's relation links charge to ideal deposited mass; actual height also depends on current efficiency, active area and edge current.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 固定圖形密度比較電荷與高度斜率，檢查中心至邊緣殘差。 必須排除的錯判：總電荷相同必有相同每顆柱高。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare charge–height slopes at fixed pattern density and inspect center-to-edge residuals. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal total charge gives equal height at every pillar. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 阻障與焊料帽｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Barrier and solder cap | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對阻障與焊料帽，把「阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For barrier and solder cap, turn "Barrier and solder cap participate in diffusion and reaction; reporting total bump height hides deficient individual layers." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 阻障與焊料帽：機制
knowledge.text: 阻障層與焊料帽在接合中參與擴散與反應；只報總凸塊高會掩蓋各層厚度不足。
knowledge.textEn: Barrier and solder cap participate in diffusion and reaction; reporting total bump height hides deficient individual layers.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 必須排除的錯判：總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Misinterpretation to reject: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 剪切測試的破壞位置｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Shear-test failure locus | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對剪切測試的破壞位置，把「剪切力需連同工具高度、加載方向與破面位置解讀；高峰值也可能來自不相關結構受力。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For shear-test failure locus, turn "Interpret shear force with tool height, loading direction and fracture locus; a high peak can include unrelated structural loading." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 標示破面在柱身、焊料或焊墊，對照相同幾何的樣本而非只比牛頓數。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Locate fracture in pillar, solder or pad, comparing matched geometry rather than force alone. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：最高剪切力必定代表最佳接合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming the highest shear force identifies the best interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 剪切測試的破壞位置：機制
knowledge.text: 剪切力需連同工具高度、加載方向與破面位置解讀；高峰值也可能來自不相關結構受力。
knowledge.textEn: Interpret shear force with tool height, loading direction and fracture locus; a high peak can include unrelated structural loading.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 標示破面在柱身、焊料或焊墊，對照相同幾何的樣本而非只比牛頓數。 必須排除的錯判：最高剪切力必定代表最佳接合界面。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Locate fracture in pillar, solder or pad, comparing matched geometry rather than force alone. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming the highest shear force identifies the best interface. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 組裝交接與抽樣｜證據與診斷
selectedSteps.titleEn: Assembly handoff and sampling | evidence and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 針對組裝交接與抽樣，把「後段需要柱高、偏心、帽體積與污染的聯合分布；單一合格率不能表示多條件共同成功率。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For assembly handoff and sampling, turn "Assembly needs joint distributions of height, eccentricity, cap volume and contamination; one yield does not represent joint success." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 交付可追溯晶粒地圖及不確定度，挑選邊緣條件樣本進行接合驗證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Deliver traceable die maps with uncertainty and include edge-condition samples in bonding validation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：各項各自合格就保證所有凸塊組裝成功。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming individual parameter passes guarantee all-bump assembly. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 組裝交接與抽樣：機制
knowledge.text: 後段需要柱高、偏心、帽體積與污染的聯合分布；單一合格率不能表示多條件共同成功率。
knowledge.textEn: Assembly needs joint distributions of height, eccentricity, cap volume and contamination; one yield does not represent joint success.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 交付可追溯晶粒地圖及不確定度，挑選邊緣條件樣本進行接合驗證。 必須排除的錯判：各項各自合格就保證所有凸塊組裝成功。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Deliver traceable die maps with uncertainty and include edge-condition samples in bonding validation. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming individual parameter passes guarantee all-bump assembly. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 接合堆疊剖面｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.objective: 針對接合堆疊剖面，把「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For bond-stack cross-section, turn "Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 接合堆疊剖面：機制
knowledge.text: 上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。
knowledge.textEn: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 必須排除的錯判：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 溫度讀值與界面溫度｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Sensor versus interface temperature | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對溫度讀值與界面溫度，把「工具感測溫度與接合界面有熱阻、熱容量和延遲；相同設定不保證不同堆疊的相同熱歷程。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For sensor versus interface temperature, turn "Tool sensors and bond interfaces differ through thermal resistance, capacity and delay; identical settings need not yield identical histories." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較見證件的界面溫度與工具曲線，記錄校正位置和誤差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare witness-interface and tool-temperature traces with calibration location and uncertainty. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：工具達設定溫度代表所有界面已同步。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming a tool setpoint means every interface is synchronized. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.text: 工具感測溫度與接合界面有熱阻、熱容量和延遲；相同設定不保證不同堆疊的相同熱歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Tool sensors and bond interfaces differ through thermal resistance, capacity and delay; identical settings need not yield identical histories.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較見證件的界面溫度與工具曲線，記錄校正位置和誤差。 必須排除的錯判：工具達設定溫度代表所有界面已同步。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare witness-interface and tool-temperature traces with calibration location and uncertainty. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming a tool setpoint means every interface is synchronized. selectedSteps.title: 氧化與潤濕證據｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Oxide and wetting evidence | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對氧化與潤濕證據，把「未潤濕、污染與接觸不足可呈相似高電阻，需界面化學或形貌證據才能分辨。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For oxide and wetting evidence, turn "Nonwetting, contamination and inadequate contact can all give high resistance; interface chemistry or morphology is needed to distinguish them." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較接合面、開路位置與良品對照，避免只用一张低倍率截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：高電阻一律表示加熱不足。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 氧化與潤濕證據：機制
knowledge.text: 未潤濕、污染與接觸不足可呈相似高電阻，需界面化學或形貌證據才能分辨。
knowledge.textEn: Nonwetting, contamination and inadequate contact can all give high resistance; interface chemistry or morphology is needed to distinguish them.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較接合面、開路位置與良品對照，避免只用一张低倍率截面。 必須排除的錯判：高電阻一律表示加熱不足。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Misinterpretation to reject: Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 冷卻殘餘應力｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Residual stress during cooling | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對冷卻殘餘應力，把「卸載與冷卻順序改變約束狀態，熱態良好接觸可能在降溫後轉為裂紋。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For residual stress during cooling, turn "Unloading and cooling alter constraints; good hot contact can become cracked after cooling." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較熱態、冷態翹曲及開路分布，先固定相同量測支撐條件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare hot/cold warpage and open maps with consistent measurement supports. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：熱態電性通過即可省略冷態重測。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping cold retest after a hot electrical pass. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 冷卻殘餘應力：機制
knowledge.text: 卸載與冷卻順序改變約束狀態，熱態良好接觸可能在降溫後轉為裂紋。
knowledge.textEn: Unloading and cooling alter constraints; good hot contact can become cracked after cooling.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較熱態、冷態翹曲及開路分布，先固定相同量測支撐條件。 必須排除的錯判：熱態電性通過即可省略冷態重測。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare hot/cold warpage and open maps with consistent measurement supports. Misinterpretation to reject: Skipping cold retest after a hot electrical pass. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 接合窗口的轉移限制｜證據與診斷
selectedSteps.titleEn: Limits of process-window transfer | evidence and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 針對接合窗口的轉移限制，把「工具、材料、晶粒尺寸與間距變更會改變接觸和熱歷程，舊窗口須用見證件重新建立。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For limits of process-window transfer, turn "Tool, material, die-size and pitch changes alter contact and thermal histories; qualify transferred windows using witnesses." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 列變更矩陣與保留條件，至少含幾何、電性、界面和熱循環證據。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：相同型號設備可直接共用全部設定。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Transferring every setting unchanged between nominally identical tools. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 接合窗口的轉移限制：機制
knowledge.text: 工具、材料、晶粒尺寸與間距變更會改變接觸和熱歷程，舊窗口須用見證件重新建立。
knowledge.textEn: Tool, material, die-size and pitch changes alter contact and thermal histories; qualify transferred windows using witnesses.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 列變更矩陣與保留條件，至少含幾何、電性、界面和熱循環證據。 必須排除的錯判：相同型號設備可直接共用全部設定。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Misinterpretation to reject: Transferring every setting unchanged between nominally identical tools. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 銅與介電界面區分｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對銅與介電界面區分，把「直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces, turn "Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 銅與介電界面區分：機制
knowledge.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces: mechanism
knowledge.text: 直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。
knowledge.textEn: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 必須排除的錯判：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 銅凹陷與突出｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Cu recess and protrusion | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對銅凹陷與突出，把「金屬相對周邊的高度決定最先接觸區和局部承壓，平均平坦不保證每個焊墊足夠接觸。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For cu recess and protrusion, turn "Metal height relative to surroundings determines initial contact and local load; mean flatness does not guarantee all-pad contact." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 以跨焊墊線掃描量相對高度，記錄相鄰介電質作基準的方法。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Measure cross-pad height relative to adjacent dielectric and document the reference plane. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：全片翹曲小即可不量局部銅凹陷。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring local Cu recess when wafer warpage is small. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 銅凹陷與突出：機制
knowledge.text: 金屬相對周邊的高度決定最先接觸區和局部承壓，平均平坦不保證每個焊墊足夠接觸。

Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

selectedSteps.title: 晶粒取向與界面遷移｜機制與設計

selectedSteps.objective: 針對晶粒取向與界面遷移，把「銅晶粒的取向和界面遷移會影響接合演化，初始接觸消失不等於所有區域皆連續。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

selectedSteps.observation: 用多位置截面或取向分析對照電性，標注取樣偏差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

selectedSteps.failure: 避免：一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one seam-free section to certify the whole interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 晶粒取向與界面遷移：機制
knowledge.titleEn: Grain orientation and interface migration: mechanism
knowledge.text: 銅晶粒的取向和界面遷移會影響接合演化，初始接觸消失不等於所有區域皆連續。

selectedSteps.title: 界面強度與能量｜機制與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Interface strength and energy | mechanism and design
selectedSteps.objective: 針對界面強度與能量，把「拉力或剪力峰值依試片幾何，界面斷裂能須考慮裂紋路徑與模式混合。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

selectedSteps.failure: 避免：把不同試片的峰值力當成材料固有強度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

knowledge.title: 界面強度與能量：機制
knowledge.text: 拉力或剪力峰值依試片幾何，界面斷裂能須考慮裂紋路徑與模式混合。

knowledge.text: 標記裂紋是否留在界面，報告載入方向、面積和破面影像。 必須排除的錯判：把不同試片的峰值力當成材料固有強度。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。

selectedSteps.title: 接合界面交接｜證據與診斷
selectedSteps.titleEn: Interface qualification handoff | evidence and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 針對接合界面交接，把「可接受條件須同時包含面積覆蓋、阻值分布、強度及後續熱預算，不只設備顯示完成。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

knowledge.title: 接合界面交接：機制
knowledge.text: 可接受條件須同時包含面積覆蓋、阻值分布、強度及後續熱預算，不只設備顯示完成。

knowledge.text: 建立批次證據包並列出未覆蓋的面積或應力範圍。 必須排除的錯判：設備流程完成即代表界面已合格。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。

selectedSteps.title: 已知良品置信度｜機制與設計

knowledge.title: 已知良品置信度：機制

knowledge.textEn: Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨

selectedSteps.objectiveEn: For local cu recess, turn "Per-die pad-height distribution controls contact; wafer means hide die-level tails." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
selectedSteps.observation: 量中心和四角焊墊的相對高度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Measure pad-relative height at center and corners. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 避免：平均高度合格即排除局部未接觸。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Avoid: Using mean height to rule out local noncontact. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the 90% example at 95% and compare loss and temperature rise. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限
knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設 5 V 降到 1 V、負載 10 A、效率 90%，輸出 10 W，輸入 11.11 W，總損耗 1.11 W。熱阻假設 15 K/W 時溫升 16.7 K；這不是特定封裝的額定值。 理想 buck 公式用於教學起點；磁芯非線性、寄生、控制模式與散熱邊界都會改變實際波形。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 5-to-1 V conversion, 10 A load and 90% efficiency, output is 10 W, input 11.11 W and loss 1.11 W. At assumed 15 K/W thermal resistance, rise is 16.7 K; this is not a package rating. Ideal buck equations are teaching starting points; magnetic nonlinearity, parasitics, control mode and thermal boundaries alter real waveforms.

selectedSteps.title: 制定模組驗收矩陣：反證與驗收

selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Test the define module acceptance matrix model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
selectedSteps.observation: 觀察焦點：選三個邊界工作點，交付效率、瞬態與最高溫度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Observation focus: Choose three boundary operating points and deliver efficiency, transient and peak temperature. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
selectedSteps.failure: 需排除的錯判：效率相同代表最高接面溫度相同。本步先檢查「制定模組驗收矩陣」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到驗收要涵蓋輸入範圍、負載、環境及故障恢復，而非只一張效率曲線。所指出的物理限制。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal efficiency implies equal peak junction temperature. First check whether evidence for define module acceptance matrix actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Acceptance covers input range, load, environment and fault recovery, not only one efficiency curve.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限
knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設 TIM 厚 50 μm、k=5 W/(m·K)、面積 100 mm²，R=0.1 K/W；20 W 導熱造成 2 K 溫差。厚度 ±10 μm 使此項 R 為 0.08–0.12 K/W，未含接觸。 R=t/(kA) 適用均勻一維導熱；局部熱點、接觸粗糙與擴散電阻須另外處理，不能用材料 k 直接替代整組封裝表現。
knowledge.textEn: Assume TIM thickness 50 μm, k=5 W/(m·K), area 100 mm²: R=0.1 K/W, giving 2 K at 20 W. Thickness ±10 μm yields 0.08–0.12 K/W, excluding contact resistance. R=t/(kA) assumes uniform one-dimensional conduction; hotspots, rough contact and spreading resistance require additional treatment.

selectedSteps.observation: 觀察焦點：為熱、機械與材料資料各列一項尚未解決的不確定度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

selectedSteps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Lid surface temperature directly equals junction temperature. First check whether evidence for deliver interface release evidence actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Yield assessment needs resistance spread, thickness distribution and aging drift, not just vendor k.

knowledge.title: 交付界面放行資料：機制
knowledge.text: 良率判斷需涵蓋熱阻散布、厚度分布與老化後漂移，非只供應商 k 值。

Parallel resistance assumes equal reference temperatures and a lumped source; unequal coolants and hotspots need a full network.

selectedSteps.observation: 使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。
knowledge.textEn: Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。 不可推成：輸出變亮一定表示位置更準
knowledge.textEn: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change. Do not infer: Higher output always means better position

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

selectedSteps.title: 區分位置與偏振：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate position and polarization: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立區分位置與偏振的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for separate position and polarization.
selectedSteps.observation: 固定位置掃偏振，再固定偏振掃位置，分離兩個響應。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Sweep polarization at fixed position, then position at fixed polarization.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「偏振可以交由位置搜尋完全補償」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Position search fully compensates polarization" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 偏振變化會改變耦合，若搜尋時偏振不穩定，功率梯度不再單純代表位置。
knowledge.textEn: Polarization changes coupling; unstable polarization corrupts positional gradients.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.textEn: Sweep polarization at fixed position, then position at fixed polarization. Do not infer: Position search fully compensates polarization

selectedSteps.titleEn: Set an array objective: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立設定陣列目標函數的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for set an array objective.
selectedSteps.observation: 以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「總功率最大即每通道都最佳」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Maximum total power means every channel is optimum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 最大總功率可能犧牲最差通道；量產目標要明定最小值、平均值或加權值。
knowledge.textEn: Maximum total power can sacrifice the worst channel; state minimum, mean or weighted objectives.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。 不可推成：總功率最大即每通道都最佳
knowledge.textEn: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels. Do not infer: Maximum total power means every channel is optimum

selectedSteps.title: 追蹤固化與釋放：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Track cure and release: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立追蹤固化與釋放的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for track cure and release.
selectedSteps.observation: 連續記錄固化、冷卻和釋放三段功率及平台位置。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Log power and position through cure, cooling and release.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「只要固化前最佳就能直接出貨」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A pre-cure optimum is sufficient for shipment" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 膠收縮與夾持卸載會把最佳位置移走，固化前最佳值不是最終交付值。
knowledge.textEn: Cure shrinkage and fixture unloading shift the optimum; pre-cure performance is not final performance.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 連續記錄固化、冷卻和釋放三段功率及平台位置。 不可推成：只要固化前最佳就能直接出貨
knowledge.textEn: Log power and position through cure, cooling and release. Do not infer: A pre-cure optimum is sufficient for shipment

knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。

selectedSteps.title: 交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別
selectedSteps.titleEn: Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 用交付可重複定位結果的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of deliver repeatable alignment results to distinguish competing explanations.
selectedSteps.observation: 重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「單次最高功率足以代表組裝良率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "One maximum-power result represents assembly yield" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 定位重複性、固化穩定性與跨通道最差損耗應分開統計。
knowledge.textEn: Alignment repeatability, cured stability and worst-channel loss need separate statistics.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。 不可推成：單次最高功率足以代表組裝良率
knowledge.textEn: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result. Do not infer: One maximum-power result represents assembly yield

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。

Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. selectedSteps.title: 設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立設定機械與光學基準的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for set mechanical and optical datums.
selectedSteps.observation: 把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「晶片切邊就是光學中心的精確基準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 晶片邊緣不一定與波導端點共線；裝配需定義可量測的基準轉換。
knowledge.textEn: The chip edge need not coincide with waveguide endpoints; assembly requires measurable datum transforms.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。 不可推成：晶片切邊就是光學中心的精確基準
knowledge.textEn: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map. Do not infer: A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。
knowledge.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

selectedSteps.title: 區分固定與隨機誤差：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate systematic and random error: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立區分固定與隨機誤差的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for separate systematic and random error.
selectedSteps.observation: 用批次平均與批次內殘差分層統計位置。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Separate between-lot mean offsets from within-lot residuals.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「通道越多共同偏差越小」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "More channels reduce common bias" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 共同遮罩偏移或標尺偏差影響所有通道，不能假設以多通道平均消失。
knowledge.textEn: Shared mask or scale bias affects every channel and need not average away.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 用批次平均與批次內殘差分層統計位置。 不可推成：通道越多共同偏差越小
knowledge.textEn: Separate between-lot mean offsets from within-lot residuals. Do not infer: More channels reduce common bias

selectedSteps.title: 分配纖距公差：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Allocate fiber-pitch tolerances: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立分配纖距公差的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for allocate fiber-pitch tolerances.
selectedSteps.observation: 繪製通道序號對位置誤差並擬合斜率。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Plot position error by channel number and fit the slope.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「只測中間纖芯足以驗證整排」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Testing the middle core validates the entire array" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 共同節距誤差隨通道距離累積；中心通道良好不能保證邊緣通道。
knowledge.textEn: Common pitch error accumulates with channel distance; good center coupling does not qualify edge channels.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.textEn: Plot position error by channel number and fit the slope. Do not infer: Testing the middle core validates the entire array

selectedSteps.title: 評估蓋板與預壓：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Assess lid and preload: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立評估蓋板與預壓的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for assess lid and preload.
selectedSteps.observation: 在不同夾持條件比較每通道高度及損耗。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare channel heights and losses under different clamping states.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「蓋板一壓所有自由度都完全固定」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A lid fully constrains every degree of freedom" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 壓住纖維只限制特定自由度；預壓不均可改變通道高度和玻璃應力。
knowledge.textEn: A lid constrains selected degrees of freedom; uneven preload shifts heights and stresses glass.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 在不同夾持條件比較每通道高度及損耗。 不可推成：蓋板一壓所有自由度都完全固定
knowledge.textEn: Compare channel heights and losses under different clamping states. Do not infer: A lid fully constrains every degree of freedom

selectedSteps.title: 交付可製造性證據：量測與判別
selectedSteps.titleEn: Deliver manufacturability evidence: measurement and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 用交付可製造性證據的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of deliver manufacturability evidence to distinguish competing explanations.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較跨批次合格比例與返工原因，標記未量測的公差。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「被動定位必定比主動定位有更高良率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Passive alignment always yields better than active alignment" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 被動法的價值取決於公差鏈良率與檢查成本，不能只比較單次裝配速度。
knowledge.textEn: Passive alignment value depends on tolerance-chain yield and inspection cost, not one assembly time.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 比較跨批次合格比例與返工原因，標記未量測的公差。 不可推成：被動定位必定比主動定位有更高良率
knowledge.textEn: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances. Do not infer: Passive alignment always yields better than active alignment

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。
knowledge.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移
titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift

selectedSteps.title: 選擇黏著位置：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Choose adhesive placement: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立選擇黏著位置的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

selectedSteps.observation: 分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 光路內膠需評估吸收與折射率，機械固定膠則仍會透過應力影響光路。
knowledge.textEn: In-path adhesive needs absorption/index evaluation; out-of-path adhesive still affects optics through stress.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。 不可推成：膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學
knowledge.textEn: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role. Do not infer: Out-of-path adhesive cannot affect optical behavior

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
knowledge.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance. Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.

selectedSteps.titleEn: Deliver attachment-life evidence: measurement and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 用交付附著壽命證據的量測證據區分競爭解釋。

selectedSteps.observation: 保留每通道完整歷程與失效分類，避免只報平均。

knowledge.text: 初始插損、溫漂、殘留位移與老化條件是不同指標，需逐項報告。

selectedSteps.titleEn: Define polarization-resolved ports: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立定義偏振端口的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define polarization-resolved ports.
selectedSteps.observation: 畫座標及每個端口允許的模式，核對注入模式名稱。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Draw coordinates and supported modes at each port and check excitation labels.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「TE 就是任何照片中的水平方向」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: TE/TM 標籤以波導主電場和傳播軸定義，不能直接沿用光纖接頭的上下方向。
knowledge.textEn: TE/TM labels depend on waveguide field and propagation axes, not simply connector orientation.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.textEn: Draw coordinates and supported modes at each port and check excitation labels. Do not infer: TE always means horizontal in a photograph

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想輸入 1 mW，目標端口功率 0.800 mW、洩漏端口 0.008 mW，端口消光比 10log10(0.800/0.008)=20 dB；兩端口總傳輸 0.808 對應 0.926 dB 損耗。消光比和總傳輸是不同量，尚未單獨量出偏振旋轉效率。 端口功率、偏振純度與高階模態含量必須分別定義；僅測總功率不能證明 TE/TM 旋轉。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input, 0.800 mW desired-port and 0.008 mW leakage power give 20 dB port extinction. Total transmission 0.808 implies 0.926 dB loss. Extinction and total transmission differ; rotation efficiency is not separately determined. Define port power, polarization purity and higher-order modal content separately; total power alone cannot prove TE/TM rotation.

knowledge.text: 線性互易元件有互易關係，但反向注入需對應正確端口與模式。
knowledge.textEn: A linear reciprocal device obeys reciprocity only with correctly matched ports and modes.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 以互換源與監測模式的測試核對 S 矩陣對稱關係。 不可推成：反向從任意模式注入都會回到原模式
knowledge.textEn: Swap source and monitor modes to check S-matrix reciprocity. Do not infer: Any reverse input mode returns to the original mode

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想輸入 1 mW，目標端口功率 0.800 mW、洩漏端口 0.008 mW，端口消光比 10log10(0.800/0.008)=20 dB；兩端口總傳輸 0.808 對應 0.926 dB 損耗。消光比和總傳輸是不同量，尚未單獨量出偏振旋轉效率。 端口功率、偏振純度與高階模態含量必須分別定義；僅測總功率不能證明 TE/TM 旋轉。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input, 0.800 mW desired-port and 0.008 mW leakage power give 20 dB port extinction. Total transmission 0.808 implies 0.926 dB loss. Extinction and total transmission differ; rotation efficiency is not separately determined. Define port power, polarization purity and higher-order modal content separately; total power alone cannot prove TE/TM rotation.

knowledge.text: 多模區內不同傳播常數累積相位差，在特定長度重建一個或多個像。

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。 自成像近似只提供初估，需以足夠模態、正確端口和波長掃描驗證；數值收斂與實物校準是不同工作。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss. Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.

selectedSteps.objective: 建立定義波導與間隙的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define guides and gap.
selectedSteps.observation: 在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「中心距和間隙可以互換使用」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 耦合由倏逝場重疊決定，間隙是側壁之間距離而非中心距離。
knowledge.textEn: Coupling follows evanescent-field overlap; gap means sidewall spacing, not center spacing.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 在截面圖分開寬度、中心距和側壁間距。 不可推成：中心距和間隙可以互換使用
knowledge.textEn: Mark width, center spacing and sidewall gap separately. Do not infer: Center spacing and gap are interchangeable

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm. The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.

selectedSteps.titleEn: Analyze gap sensitivity: model and design

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm. The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.

selectedSteps.titleEn: Define arms and ports: model and design

knowledge.textEn: Output adds complex arm fields and distributes energy to complementary ports; powers alone cannot describe it.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴. The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.

selectedSteps.objective: 建立設定正交偏壓的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

knowledge.text: 有效模型需保存複數折射率、電容、電阻、電極傳輸和偏壓範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A useful model includes complex index, capacitance, resistance, electrode propagation and bias bounds.

knowledge.text: 用獨立偏壓點驗證模型預測，而非只重播擬合資料。 不可推成：吻合一個偏壓即可證明全範圍模型

selectedSteps.title: 建立回程相位：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Establish round-trip phase: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立建立回程相位的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for establish round-trip phase.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較加長環與增加有效折射率造成的共振移動。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare resonance shifts from longer circumference and higher effective index.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「只要半徑相同共振波長一定相同」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Equal radii guarantee equal resonance wavelengths" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 共振要求回程相位為整數 2π，幾何周長與有效折射率共同決定位置。
knowledge.textEn: Resonance requires integer-2π round-trip phase, set jointly by circumference and effective index.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 比較加長環與增加有效折射率造成的共振移動。 不可推成：只要半徑相同共振波長一定相同
knowledge.textEn: Compare resonance shifts from longer circumference and higher effective index. Do not infer: Equal radii guarantee equal resonance wavelengths

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。 FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical r=10 μm, n_g=4 and λ=1550 nm, circumference is 62.832 μm and local FSR≈9.559 nm. Loaded Q=10000 gives 0.155 nm linewidth. An assumed 80 pm/K drift over 2 K shifts resonance 0.160 nm, about one linewidth. FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.

selectedSteps.title: 區分載入與內部 Q：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate loaded and intrinsic Q: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立區分載入與內部 Q的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

selectedSteps.observation: 比較同一內損耗下不同耦合強度的線寬。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare linewidth for different coupling at fixed intrinsic loss.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「量到的載入 Q 就是材料本身 Q」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Measured loaded Q equals material Q" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 載入損耗包含內部與耦合通道，1/Q_loaded=1/Q_internal+1/Q_coupling。
knowledge.textEn: Loaded decay includes intrinsic and coupling channels, with inverse Q values adding.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 比較同一內損耗下不同耦合強度的線寬。 不可推成：量到的載入 Q 就是材料本身 Q

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍

selectedSteps.titleEn: Define heater and optical regions: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立定義加熱與光學區的可驗證模型及適用邊界。

selectedSteps.observationEn: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section.

knowledge.textEn: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section. Do not infer: Moving a heater closer to the optical core has only benefits

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms. The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms. The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.

selectedSteps.title: 交付控制模型：量測與判別
selectedSteps.titleEn: Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 用交付控制模型的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of deliver a control model to distinguish competing explanations.
selectedSteps.observation: 以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「知道 Pπ 即可完成所有控制設計」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Pπ alone completes control design" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 控制器需要功率—相位曲線、動態、串擾與工作範圍，而非只有 Pπ。
knowledge.textEn: A controller needs power-phase curves, dynamics, crosstalk and bounds, not only Pπ.

knowledge.text: 以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。 不可推成：知道 Pπ 即可完成所有控制設計

selectedSteps.title: 定義接面與反向偏壓：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Define junction and reverse bias: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立定義接面與反向偏壓的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define junction and reverse bias.
selectedSteps.observation: 畫 p/n 區、電壓極性與耗盡變化方向。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「耗盡調變就是正向注入載子」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 反向偏壓擴大耗盡區，改變與光模態重疊的自由載子，不是注入大量少數載子。
knowledge.textEn: Reverse bias widens depletion and changes free carriers overlapping the mode, rather than injecting many minority carriers.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 畫 p/n 區、電壓極性與耗盡變化方向。 不可推成：耗盡調變就是正向注入載子
knowledge.textEn: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion. Do not infer: Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。 Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth. Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.

selectedSteps.title: 同時追蹤吸收：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Track absorption alongside phase: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立同時追蹤吸收的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for track absorption alongside phase.
selectedSteps.observation: 在每個偏壓提取複數模態指標及傳播損耗。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Extract complex modal index and propagation loss at each bias.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「載子改變只影響相位而不影響損耗」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Carrier changes affect phase but never loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 自由載子變化會改變折射率與吸收，效率與插損不能以單一實數模型完全描述。
knowledge.textEn: Carrier changes affect both index and absorption; one real-index model cannot capture efficiency and loss.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.textEn: Extract complex modal index and propagation loss at each bias. Do not infer: Carrier changes affect phase but never loss

selectedSteps.title: 界定串聯電阻：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Define series resistance: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立界定串聯電阻的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define series resistance.
selectedSteps.observation: 用等效電路標出源、接觸與接面，檢查去嵌位置。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Map source, contacts and junction in the equivalent circuit and check de-embedding planes.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「50 Ω 儀器介面代表元件內部電阻一定 50 Ω」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A 50 Ω instrument implies a 50 Ω internal device" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 接觸、摻雜導電區與驅動源共同限制充放電，需說明 R 所含邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Contacts, doped access regions and the driver limit charging; define which contributions are in R.

selectedSteps.title: 區分儲能與每位元能量：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Separate stored energy and energy per bit: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 建立區分儲能與每位元能量的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for separate stored energy and energy per bit.
selectedSteps.observation: 列出電壓擺幅定義與資料轉換率再計功耗。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Specify swing convention and transition rate before calculating power.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「½CV² 在所有驅動方式都等於每位元能量」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "½CV² equals energy per bit for every driver" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 電容儲能 ½CV² 不是通用每位元耗能；資料轉換機率、驅動架構與回收決定平均功耗。
knowledge.textEn: Stored energy ½CV² is not universal energy per bit; transitions, driver architecture and recovery set average power.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 列出電壓擺幅定義與資料轉換率再計功耗。 不可推成：½CV² 在所有驅動方式都等於每位元能量
knowledge.textEn: Specify swing convention and transition rate before calculating power. Do not infer: ½CV² equals energy per bit for every driver

selectedSteps.title: 交付一致偏壓模型：量測與判別
selectedSteps.titleEn: Deliver a consistent bias model: measurement and diagnosis
selectedSteps.objective: 用交付一致偏壓模型的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of deliver a consistent bias model to distinguish competing explanations.
selectedSteps.observation: 用同一器件資料集預測 MZI 或微環響應並留獨立驗證點。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Predict MZI/ring response from one consistent dataset and reserve independent validation points.
selectedSteps.failure: 錯誤推論「可以把不同樣品的最佳數值組成一顆理想元件」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Best values from different samples form a valid ideal device" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 相移、吸收、電容與電阻必須來自相同幾何偏壓條件，混搭最佳值會失真。
knowledge.textEn: Phase, absorption, capacitance and resistance must share geometry/bias conditions; combining unrelated best values distorts predictions.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 用同一器件資料集預測 MZI 或微環響應並留獨立驗證點。 不可推成：可以把不同樣品的最佳數值組成一顆理想元件
knowledge.textEn: Predict MZI/ring response from one consistent dataset and reserve independent validation points. Do not infer: Best values from different samples form a valid ideal device

selectedSteps.title: 晶軸與偏振：模型與設計
selectedSteps.titleEn: Crystal axes and polarization: model and design
selectedSteps.objective: 以「晶軸與偏振」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for crystal axes and polarization, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
selectedSteps.observation: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
selectedSteps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。
knowledge.textEn: Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
knowledge.textEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Δφ≈πV/Vπ；小訊號模型還需電光重疊與行波衰減。 電極定義、偏振及波長固定；不能把教學 VπL 視為商用品規格。
knowledge.textEn: Δφ≈πV/Vπ; a small-signal model also needs electro-optic overlap and traveling-wave attenuation. Fix electrode definition, polarization and wavelength; the teaching VπL is not a commercial specification.

selectedSteps.title: 界面間隙：模型與設計
selectedSteps.objective: 以「界面間隙」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for interface gap, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
selectedSteps.observation: 把截面量測與沿線散射位置對照，區分均勻間隙偏移和局部接合缺陷。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Correlate cross sections with scattering positions to separate uniform gap shifts from local bonding defects.
selectedSteps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

knowledge.text: 接合層厚度改變混合模態與垂直耦合，均勻平均值不能揭露局部空洞。
knowledge.textEn: Bond-layer thickness changes hybrid modes and vertical coupling; a uniform mean does not reveal local voids.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 把截面量測與沿線散射位置對照，區分均勻間隙偏移和局部接合缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Correlate cross sections with scattering positions to separate uniform gap shifts from local bonding defects.

knowledge.textEn: Compare RF effective index with optical group index, not optical phase index.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據

knowledge.textEn: FSRν≈c/(ngL); locally FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL); recalculate when group index varies with frequency. Single mode, local approximation and hypothetical group index; coupler phase dispersion, thermal drift and process distributions are excluded.

selectedSteps.title: 轉印材料：模型與設計
selectedSteps.objective: 以「轉印材料」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
selectedSteps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for transfer-printed materials, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
selectedSteps.observation: 比較加入元件前後的損耗、相位和電性能，避免只看功能是否出現。
selectedSteps.observationEn: Compare loss, phase and electrical behavior before/after integration, not merely function presence.
selectedSteps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
selectedSteps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

knowledge.text: 微轉印讓不同材料提供局部功能，但定位、界面和重複性仍需驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Micro-transfer printing adds local material functions but still requires alignment, interface and repeatability validation.
